theorem Real.tsum_eq_tsum_fourier_of_rpow_decay_of_summable {f : ℝ → ℂ} (hc : Continuous f)
    {b : ℝ} (hb : 1 < b) (hf : IsBigO (cocompact ℝ) f fun x : ℝ => |x| ^ (-b))
    (hFf : Summable fun n : ℤ => 𝓕 f n) (x : ℝ) :
    ∑' n : ℤ, f (x + n) = ∑' n : ℤ, 𝓕 f n * fourier n (x : UnitAddCircle) :=
  Real.tsum_eq_tsum_fourier (fun K => summable_of_isBigO (Real.summable_abs_int_rpow hb)

/-- Twisting by `e(αu)` translates the Fourier transform. -/
theorem fourier_mul_e (f : ℝ → ℂ) (α ξ : ℝ) :
    𝓕 (fun u => f u * e (α * u)) ξ = 𝓕 f (ξ - α) := by
  rw [fourier_eq_integral_e, fourier_eq_integral_e]
  congr 1; funext v
  rw [mul_comm (f v), ← mul_assoc, ← e_add]; congr 2; ring

proof_context.conclusion: `𝓕 (f·e(α·)) ξ = 𝓕 f (ξ-α)`, the twist by `e(αu)` translates the Fourier transform.

/-- `∑_{n ∈ ℤ} 1/(n - s)² = π²/sin²(πs)` for `s ∉ ℤ`, via Parseval for `e(sx)` on `[0, 1]`. -/
theorem hasSum_inv_sq_sub {s : ℝ} (hs : Real.sin (π * s) ≠ 0) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℤ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) - s) ^ 2) (π ^ 2 / Real.sin (π * s) ^ 2) := by
  have hsn : ∀ n : ℤ, s ≠ n := by
    intro n h; apply hs; rw [h, mul_comm]; exact Real.sin_int_mul_pi n
  have hL2 : MemLp (fun x : ℝ => e (s * x)) 2 (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc 0 1)) :=
    MemLp.of_bound ((continuous_e.comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable)
      1 (ae_of_all _ fun x => by simp [norm_e])
  have h := hasSum_sq_fourierCoeffOn zero_lt_one hL2
  simp only [norm_e, one_pow, intervalIntegral.integral_const, sub_zero, inv_one,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h
  have hterm : ∀ n : ℤ, ‖fourierCoeffOn zero_lt_one (fun x => e (s * x)) n‖ ^ 2 =
      Real.sin (π * s) ^ 2 / π ^ 2 * (1 / ((n : ℝ) - s) ^ 2) := by
    intro n
    have hne : (s : ℝ) - n ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 (hsn n)
    rw [fourierCoeffOn_e_mul n (hsn n), norm_div, div_pow, norm_e_sub_one_sq]
    have : ‖(2 * π * I * ((s : ℂ) - n))‖ = 2 * π * |s - n| := by
      have h1 : ((s : ℂ) - n) = ((s - n : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [h1, norm_mul, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos, Complex.norm_ofNat, mul_one]
    rw [this]
    have : (n - s) ^ 2 = |s - n| ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]; ring
    rw [this]
    have := abs_pos.2 hne
    field_simp
    ring
  simp_rw [hterm] at h
  have hk : Real.sin (π * s) ^ 2 / π ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have := h.mul_left (π ^ 2 / Real.sin (π * s) ^ 2)
  convert this using 1
  · funext n; rw [← mul_assoc, div_mul_div_comm, mul_comm (π ^ 2), div_self (by positivity), one_mul]
  · ring

proof_context.conclusion: `∑_{n∈ℤ} 1/(n-s)² = π²/sin²(πs)` for `sin πs ≠ 0`, proved via Parseval for `e(sx)` on `[0,1]`.

set N := ⌊y⌋
  have hfl : ⌊y + q⌋ = N + q := by
    have := Int.floor_add_intCast y (q : ℤ); push_cast at this; exact this
  rw [hfl]
  set S := Finset.Ioc N (N + q)
  set c : ℝ := N + (q + 1) / 2
  have hdist : ∀ n ∈ S, |(n : ℝ) - c| ≤ q / 2 := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hn
    have h1 : (N : ℝ) + 1 ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : N + 1 ≤ n)
    have h2 : (n : ℝ) ≤ N + q := by exact_mod_cast hn.2
    rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> simp only [c] <;> linarith

proof_context.conclusion: Sets c = N + (q+1)/2 with N = ⌊y⌋ and shows every n in Ioc N (N+q) has |n-c| ≤ q/2 (the centred index j = n-c).

have hinj : Set.InjOn R S := by
    intro n hn n' hn' hR
    have hmod : m n % q = m n' % q := by rw [← hRcast, ← hRcast]; exact congrArg _ hR
    have hdvd : (q : ℤ) ∣ a * (n - n') := by
      have h1 : (q : ℤ) ∣ m n - m n' := Int.ModEq.dvd hmod.symm
      have : m n - m n' = σ * (a * (n - n')) := by simp only [m]; ring
      rw [this] at h1
      have h2 : (q : ℤ) ∣ σ * (σ * (a * (n - n'))) := dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h1 σ
      rwa [← mul_assoc, hσ, one_mul] at h2
    have hd : (q : ℤ) ∣ n - n' := hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hdvd
    simp only [S, Finset.coe_Ioc, Set.mem_Ioc] at hn hn'
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hd
    have : t = 0 := by
      by_contra ht0
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne ht0 with h | h
      · have : (q : ℤ) * t ≤ -q := by nlinarith
        omega
      · have : (q : ℤ) ≤ q * t := by nlinarith
        omega
    subst this; omega
  have hτR : ∀ n ∈ S, τR (R n) = τ' n := by
    intro n hn
    have hex : ∃ n' ∈ S, R n' = R n := ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩
    simp only [τR, dite_eq_left hex]
    have := hex.choose_spec
    rw [hinj this.1 hn this.2]
  refine ⟨s, hσs, hs1, τR, fun r => ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [τR]
    split_ifs with hr
    · exact hτ' _ hr.choose_spec.1
    · exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => hterm n]
    refine Finset.sum_nbij R (fun n _ => Finset.mem_range.2 (hRlt n)) hinj ?_ ?_
    · have hcard : (Finset.range q).card ≤ S.card := by
        simp only [S, Int.card_Ioc, Finset.card_range]; omega

/-- Pairing ("majorization"): for convex `f` and `a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ d` with `b + c = a + d`,
`f b + f c ≤ f a + f d`. -/
theorem _root_.ConvexOn.add_le_add_of_majorize {s : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ConvexOn ℝ s f)
    {a b c d : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ s) (hd : d ∈ s) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    (hsum : b + c = a + d) : f b + f c ≤ f a + f d := by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (hab.trans (hbc.trans hcd)) with had | had
  · have : a = b := le_antisymm hab (by linarith)
    have : c = d := le_antisymm hcd (by linarith)
    subst_vars; rfl
  have hda : d - a ≠ 0 := (sub_pos.2 had).ne'
  have hc' : c = a + d - b := by linarith
  set l := (d - b) / (d - a)
  have hl0 : 0 ≤ l := div_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hl1 : l ≤ 1 := (div_le_one (by linarith)).2 (by linarith)
  have hb : l • a + (1 - l) • d = b := by
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, l]; field_simp; ring
  have hc : (1 - l) • a + l • d = c := by
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, l]; rw [hc']; field_simp; ring
  have h1 : f (l • a + (1 - l) • d) ≤ l • f a + (1 - l) • f d :=
    hf.2 ha hd hl0 (by linarith) (by ring)
  have h2 : f ((1 - l) • a + l • d) ≤ (1 - l) • f a + l • f d :=
    hf.2 ha hd (by linarith) hl0 (by ring)
  rw [hb] at h1; rw [hc] at h2
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h1 h2
  linarith

proof_context.conclusion: For convex `f`, `a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ d`, `b+c=a+d`: `f b + f c ≤ f a + f d`.

    f m ≤ ∫ x in (m - 1 / 2)..(m + 1 / 2), f x := by
  have hint : IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume (m - 1 / 2) (m + 1 / 2) :=
    hc.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by linarith)
  -- Reflection `x ↦ 2m - x` preserves the interval.
  have hrefl : ∫ x in (m - 1 / 2)..(m + 1 / 2), f (2 * m - x) = ∫ x in (m - 1 / 2)..(m + 1 / 2), f x := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_comp_sub_left]; ring_nf
  have hint' : IntervalIntegrable (fun x => f (2 * m - x)) MeasureTheory.volume
      (m - 1 / 2) (m + 1 / 2) := by
    refine ContinuousOn.intervalIntegrable_of_Icc (by linarith) ?_
    refine hc.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).continuousOn fun x hx => ?_
    simp only [mem_Icc, id] at hx ⊢; constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2]
  have hpt : ∀ x ∈ Icc (m - 1 / 2) (m + 1 / 2), 2 * f m ≤ f x + f (2 * m - x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' : 2 * m - x ∈ s := hs ⟨by linarith [hx.2], by linarith [hx.1]⟩
    have := hf.2 (hs hx) hx' (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2)
      (by norm_num)
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at this
    rw [show 1 / 2 * x + 1 / 2 * (2 * m - x) = m by ring] at this
    linarith

/-- **I2.** For unit-spaced points `u₁, u₁ + 1, …, u₁ + m - 1` in `[1, q/2]`,
`∑ min(A, C f_q(u)) ≤ (2q/π) √(AC)`. -/
theorem sum_G_le {q A C : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hC : 0 ≤ C) {u₁ : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    (hu₁ : 1 ≤ u₁) (hlast : u₁ + m - 1 ≤ q / 2) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, min A (C * fq q (u₁ + i)) ≤ 2 * (q / π) * √(A * C) := by
  set G := fun u => min A (C * fq q u)
  have hG0 : ∀ u, 0 ≤ G u := fun u => le_min hA (mul_nonneg hC (fq_nonneg q u))
  have hII : ∀ a b, IntervalIntegrable G volume a b := intervalIntegrable_G hA hC
  -- Each term is at most the integral over the unit interval to its left.
  have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range m,
      G (u₁ + i) ≤ ∫ u in (u₁ - 1 + i)..(u₁ - 1 + (i + 1 : ℕ)), G u := by
    intro i hi
    have hi' : (i : ℝ) + 1 ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast Finset.mem_range.1 hi
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by push_cast; linarith)]
    have hvol : volume.real (Ioc (u₁ - 1 + i) (u₁ - 1 + (i + 1 : ℕ))) = 1 := by
      rw [Real.volume_real_Ioc_of_le (by push_cast; linarith)]; push_cast; ring
    calc G (u₁ + i) = ∫ _ in Ioc (u₁ - 1 + i) (u₁ - 1 + (i + 1 : ℕ)), G (u₁ + i) := by
          rw [setIntegral_const, hvol, one_smul]
      _ ≤ _ := by
          refine setIntegral_mono_on continuous_const.integrableOn_Ioc ((hII _ _).1) measurableSet_Ioc
            fun v hv => ?_
          simp only [mem_Ioc] at hv; push_cast at hv
          exact min_le_min le_rfl (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (fq_anti hq (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith)) hC)
  have hsum := intervalIntegral.sum_integral_adjacent_intervals (μ := volume) (f := G)
    (a := fun i : ℕ => u₁ - 1 + i) (n := m) fun i _ => hII _ _
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero] at hsum
  -- Compare with `∫₀^{q/2} G`.
  have hsub : ∫ u in (u₁ - 1)..(u₁ - 1 + m), G u ≤ ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..(q / 2), G u := by
    have e1 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (a := 0) (b := u₁ - 1)
      (c := q / 2) (hII 0 (u₁ - 1)) (hII (u₁ - 1) (q / 2))
    have e2 := intervalIntegral.integral_add_adjacent_intervals (a := u₁ - 1) (b := u₁ - 1 + m)
      (c := q / 2) (hII (u₁ - 1) (u₁ - 1 + m)) (hII (u₁ - 1 + m) (q / 2))
    have h1 := intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (μ := volume) (a := 0) (b := u₁ - 1)
      (by linarith) fun u _ => hG0 u
    have h2 := intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (μ := volume) (a := u₁ - 1 + m) (b := q / 2)
      (by linarith) fun u _ => hG0 u
    linarith
  -- Change of variables `v = πu/q`.
  have hcv : ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..(q / 2), G u =
      q / π * ∫ v in (0:ℝ)..(π / 2), min A (C * (1 / Real.sin v ^ 2)) := by
    have hpq : π / q ≠ 0 := (div_pos Real.pi_pos hq).ne'
    have : G = fun u => (fun v => min A (C * (1 / Real.sin v ^ 2))) ((π / q) * u) := by
      funext u; simp only [G, fq]; ring_nf
    rw [this, intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left _ hpq, smul_eq_mul, inv_div]
    congr 2 <;> field_simp <;> simp
  calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, G (u₁ + i)
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, ∫ u in (u₁ - 1 + i)..(u₁ - 1 + (i + 1 : ℕ)), G u :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum hterm
    _ = ∫ u in (u₁ - 1)..(u₁ - 1 + m), G u := hsum
    _ ≤ ∫ u in (0:ℝ)..(q / 2), G u := hsub
    _ ≤ q / π * (2 * √(A * C)) := by
        rw [hcv]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (integral_minInvSin_le hA hC) (by positivity)
    _ = 2 * (q / π) * √(A * C) := by ring

proof_context.conclusion: A unit-spaced family of min(A, C fq) terms sums to at most (2q/pi)sqrt(AC).

/-- **Reduction for Lemmas 4.1.2–4.1.3**, for any nonnegative summand `Φ(sin²(παn))`.  For `0 ≤ y₁ < n ≤ y₂ ≤ Q/2`, `q ∤ n`, `y₂ - y₁ ≤ q`, the terms

theorem residue_form_gen {α Q : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (h : Approx α a q Q) {y₁ y₂ : ℝ}
    (hy : 0 ≤ y₁) (hlen : y₂ - y₁ ≤ q) (hy₂ : y₂ ≤ Q / 2) (Φ : ℝ → ℝ) (hΦ : ∀ x, 0 ≤ Φ x) :
    ∃ τ : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ R, τ R ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) ∧
      ∑ n ∈ Finset.Ioc ⌊y₁⌋ ⌊y₂⌋,
          (if (q : ℤ) ∣ n then 0 else Φ (Real.sin (π * α * n) ^ 2)) ≤
        ∑ R ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (q - 1), Φ (Real.sin (π * (R + τ R) / q) ^ 2) := by
  obtain ⟨hq1, hcop, β, hβ, hα, hqQ⟩ := h
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  have hQ0 : 0 < Q := by linarith
  have hqz : (0 : ℤ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  set S := Finset.Ioc ⌊y₁⌋ ⌊y₂⌋
  set S' := S.filter fun n => ¬ (q : ℤ) ∣ n
  have hS : ∀ n ∈ S, 1 ≤ n ∧ (n : ℝ) ≤ y₂ := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hn
    have h0 : 0 ≤ ⌊y₁⌋ := Int.floor_nonneg.2 hy
    exact ⟨by omega, (Int.cast_le.2 hn.2).trans (Int.floor_le y₂)⟩
  have hgap : ∀ n ∈ S, ∀ n' ∈ S, n - n' < q := by
    intro n hn n' hn'
    rw [Finset.mem_Ioc] at hn hn'
    have h1 : ((n - n' : ℤ) : ℝ) < q := by
      have a1 : (n : ℝ) ≤ y₂ := (Int.cast_le.2 hn.2).trans (Int.floor_le y₂)
      have a2 : y₁ < n' := by
        have := Int.lt_floor_add_one y₁
        have : ((⌊y₁⌋ : ℤ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ n' := by exact_mod_cast hn'.1
        linarith
      push_cast; linarith
    exact_mod_cast h1
  -- Orientation.
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hσβ⟩ : ∃ σ : ℤ, σ * σ = 1 ∧ 0 ≤ (σ : ℝ) * β := by
    rcases le_or_gt 0 β with h0 | h0
    · exact ⟨1, by norm_num, by simpa using h0⟩
    · exact ⟨-1, by norm_num, by push_cast; linarith⟩
  have hσr : (σ : ℝ) * σ = 1 := by exact_mod_cast hσ
  have hσabs : |(σ : ℝ)| = 1 := by
    have : |(σ : ℝ)| * |(σ : ℝ)| = 1 := by rw [← abs_mul, hσr, abs_one]
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (σ : ℝ)]
  set τ' := fun n : ℤ => (σ : ℝ) * β * n / Q
  have hτ' : ∀ n ∈ S, τ' n ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2) := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hS n hn
    have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : (0 : ℤ) ≤ n)
    have hσβ1 : (σ : ℝ) * β ≤ 1 := by
      calc (σ : ℝ) * β ≤ |(σ : ℝ) * β| := le_abs_self _
        _ = |β| := by rw [abs_mul, hσabs, one_mul]
        _ ≤ 1 := hβ
    simp only [τ', mem_Icc]
    constructor
    · positivity
    · rw [div_le_iff₀ hQ0]; nlinarith
  set m := fun n : ℤ => σ * (a * n)
  set R := fun n : ℤ => (m n % (q : ℤ)).toNat
  have hRcast : ∀ n, ((R n : ℕ) : ℤ) = m n % q := fun n =>
    Int.toNat_of_nonneg (Int.emod_nonneg _ hqz.ne')
  have hRlt : ∀ n, R n < q := by
    intro n; simp only [R]
    have h1 := Int.emod_nonneg (m n) hqz.ne'
    have h2 := Int.emod_lt_of_pos (m n) hqz
    omega
  have hRpos : ∀ n ∈ S', 1 ≤ R n := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hn
    by_contra h0
    have h00 : m n % q = 0 := by have := hRcast n; omega
    apply hn.2
    have h1 : (q : ℤ) ∣ σ * (a * n) := Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero h00
    have h2 : (q : ℤ) ∣ σ * (σ * (a * n)) := dvd_mul_of_dvd_right h1 σ
    rw [← mul_assoc, hσ, one_mul] at h2
    exact hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h2
  have hterm : ∀ n : ℤ, Φ (Real.sin (π * α * n) ^ 2) = Φ (Real.sin (π * (R n + τ' n) / q) ^ 2) := by
    intro n

    have hm : a * n = σ * (q * (m n / q) + (R n : ℤ)) := by
      rw [hRcast, Int.mul_ediv_add_emod]; simp only [m]; rw [← mul_assoc, hσ, one_mul]
    have harg : π * α * n = (σ : ℝ) * (π * ((R n : ℝ) + τ' n) / q + ((m n / q : ℤ) : ℝ) * π) := by
      have e : π * α * n = π * (((a * n : ℤ) : ℝ) + β * n / Q) / q := by
        rw [hα]; push_cast; field_simp
      rw [e, hm]; push_cast; simp only [τ']; field_simp; ring_nf
      rw [show (σ : ℝ) ^ 2 = 1 by rw [sq, hσr]]; ring
    rw [harg]
    rcases Int.eq_one_or_neg_one_of_mul_eq_one hσ with hs | hs <;>
    · subst hs; push_cast
      simp only [one_mul, neg_one_mul, Real.sin_neg, neg_sq]
      rw [sin_sq_add_int_mul_pi]

theorem second_approx {ξ Q ε : ℝ} {a : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ))
    (hqQ : (q : ℝ) ≤ Q) (hε : 0 < ε) (hexact : |ξ - a / q| = 1 / (q * Q)) :
    ∃ (a' : ℤ) (q' : ℕ), 1 ≤ q' ∧ IsCoprime a' (q' : ℤ) ∧ (q' : ℝ) ≤ (1 + ε) * Q ∧
      |ξ - a' / q'| ≤ 1 / (q' * ((1 + ε) * Q)) ∧ ε * Q / (1 + ε) ≤ q' := by
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hQ1 : 1 ≤ Q := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hq) hqQ
  have hQ0 : 0 < Q := by linarith
  set Q' := (1 + ε) * Q
  have hQ'1 : 1 ≤ Q' := by simp only [Q']; nlinarith
  set n := ⌊Q'⌋₊
  have hn : 0 < n := Nat.floor_pos.2 hQ'1
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrden⟩ := Real.exists_rat_abs_sub_le_and_den_le ξ hn
  set a' := r.num
  set q' := r.den
  have hq'1 : 1 ≤ q' := r.den_pos
  have hq'0 : (0 : ℝ) < q' := by exact_mod_cast hq'1
  have hcast : (r : ℝ) = a' / q' := Rat.cast_def r
  have hcop' : IsCoprime a' (q' : ℤ) := by
    rw [Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one]; exact r.reduced
  have hq'Q' : (q' : ℝ) ≤ Q' := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hrden) (Nat.floor_le (by linarith))
  have hnQ' : Q' < n + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one Q'
  have happ : |ξ - a' / q'| ≤ 1 / (q' * Q') := by
    rw [← hcast]
    refine hr.trans ?_
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
    rw [mul_comm (q' : ℝ)]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hnQ'.le hq'0.le
  refine ⟨a', q', hq'1, hcop', hq'Q', happ, ?_⟩

proof_context.conclusion: For real `Q ≥ q` with `|ξ−a/q| = 1/(qQ)`, Dirichlet (Mathlib `Real.exists_rat_abs_sub_le_and_den_le` at `⌊(1+ε)Q⌋`) gives reduced `a'/q'` with `q' ≤ (1+ε)Q` and `|ξ−a'/q'| ≤ 1/(q'(1+ε)Q)`.

records.note: Carries the inequalities |a/q-a'/q'| ≥ 1/qq', the upper bound, q'/Q+q/((1+ε)Q) ≥ 1 and q' ≥ εQ/(1+ε), with real Q and Q' = (1+ε)Q (book: Q' = ⌈(1+ε)Q⌉). The parenthetical q' ≥ 2 is not proved.

ends.snippet:
have hne : a' * q ≠ a * q' := by
    intro heq
    have hqq : q = q' := by
      have h1 : (q : ℤ) ∣ q' := by
        have : (q : ℤ) ∣ a * q' := ⟨a', by rw [← heq]; ring⟩
        exact hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left this
      have h2 : (q' : ℤ) ∣ q := by
        have : (q' : ℤ) ∣ a' * q := ⟨a, by rw [heq]; ring⟩
        exact hcop'.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left this
      exact_mod_cast Int.dvd_antisymm (by positivity) (by positivity) h1 h2
    have hfrac : (a' : ℝ) / q' = a / q := by
      rw [div_eq_div_iff hq'0.ne' hq0.ne']; exact_mod_cast heq
    rw [hfrac, hexact, ← hqq] at happ
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)] at happ
    have : (q : ℝ) * Q' ≤ q * Q := by linarith
    have : Q' ≤ Q := le_of_mul_le_mul_left this hq0
    simp only [Q'] at this; nlinarith
  have hgap : 1 / ((q : ℝ) * q') ≤ |(a : ℝ) / q - a' / q'| := by
    have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |((a * q' - a' * q : ℤ) : ℝ)| := by
      exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs (sub_ne_zero.2 (Ne.symm hne))
    have : (a : ℝ) / q - a' / q' = ((a * q' - a' * q : ℤ) : ℝ) / (q * q') := by
      push_cast; field_simp
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < q * q' := mul_pos hq0 hq'0
    rw [this, abs_div, abs_of_pos hpos]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 hpos.le
  have htri : |(a : ℝ) / q - a' / q'| ≤ 1 / (q * Q) + 1 / (q' * Q') := by
    calc |(a : ℝ) / q - a' / q'| = |(ξ - a' / q') - (ξ - a / q)| := by ring_nf
      _ ≤ |ξ - a' / q'| + |ξ - a / q| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ _ := by rw [hexact]; linarith
  have key := hgap.trans htri
  -- `Q ≤ q' + q/(1+ε)`.
  have hk : Q ≤ q' + q / (1 + ε) := by
    have e : 1 / ((q : ℝ) * q') ≤ 1 / (q * Q) + 1 / (q' * Q') := key
    have : (q * q' * Q : ℝ) * (1 / (q * q')) ≤ (q * q' * Q) * (1 / (q * Q) + 1 / (q' * Q')) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left e (by positivity)
    have e1 : (q * q' * Q : ℝ) * (1 / (q * q')) = Q := by field_simp
    have e2 : (q * q' * Q : ℝ) * (1 / (q * Q) + 1 / (q' * Q')) = q' + q / (1 + ε) := by
      simp only [Q']; field_simp
    linarith
  have : (q : ℝ) / (1 + ε) ≤ Q / (1 + ε) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hqQ (by linarith)
  have e3 : ε * Q / (1 + ε) = Q - Q / (1 + ε) := by field_simp; ring
  linarith

proof_context.conclusion: From a'/q' ≠ a/q (lines 1053-1069), the gap `1/(qq') ≤ |a/q - a'/q'|`, the triangle bound `≤ 1/(qQ) + 1/(q'Q')`, hence `Q ≤ q' + q/(1+ε)` and `q' ≥ εQ/(1+ε)`.

theorem typeI_eq_main_add_rest {α x M D : ℝ} {q : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hM0 : 0 ≤ M)
    (hMD : M ≤ D) : typeI α x D = mainPart α x M q + restPart α x D M q := by
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  rw [typeI_eq_sum_Todd hx, restPart, mainPart]
  have hsplit : ∀ m ∈ Icc 1 ⌊D⌋₊, (if Odd m then (μ m : ℂ) * Todd α x m else 0) =
      (if Odd m ∧ ((q : ℕ) ∣ m ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ M) then (μ m : ℂ) * Todd α x m else 0) +
      (if Odd m ∧ ¬ ((q : ℕ) ∣ m ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ M) then (μ m : ℂ) * Todd α x m else 0) := by
    intro m _
    by_cases h1 : Odd m <;> by_cases h2 : ((q : ℕ) ∣ m ∧ (m : ℝ) ≤ M) <;> simp [h1, h2]
  rw [sum_congr rfl hsplit, sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  rw [← sum_filter, ← sum_filter]
  refine (sum_nbij' (fun m => m / q) (fun m' => q * m') ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_)
  · intro m hm
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_Icc] at hm
    obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, hodd, ⟨t, rfl⟩, hle⟩ := hm
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_Icc]
    have ht : q * t / q = t := Nat.mul_div_cancel_left t (by omega)
    rw [ht]
    have ht1 : 1 ≤ t := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos t with h | h
      · subst h; simp at h1
      · exact h
    refine ⟨⟨ht1, ?_⟩, hodd⟩
    apply Nat.le_floor
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hq0]; push_cast at hle ⊢; linarith
  · intro m' hm'
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_Icc] at hm' ⊢
    obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, hodd⟩ := hm'
    have hle : ((q * m' : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ M := by
      have := Nat.floor_le (show 0 ≤ M / q by positivity)
      have h2' : (m' : ℝ) ≤ M / q := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast h2) this
      push_cast; rw [le_div_iff₀ hq0] at h2'; linarith
    refine ⟨⟨Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 (Nat.mul_ne_zero (by omega) (by omega)), ?_⟩, hodd,
      ⟨m', rfl⟩, hle⟩
    exact Nat.le_floor (hle.trans hMD)
  · intro m hm
    simp only [mem_filter] at hm
    obtain ⟨_, _, hdvd, _⟩ := hm
    exact Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd
  · intro m' _; exact Nat.mul_div_cancel_left m' (by omega)
  · intro m hm
    simp only [mem_filter] at hm
    obtain ⟨_, hodd, hdvd, _⟩ := hm
    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' hdvd]

proof_context.conclusion: Splits `typeI α x D` into `mainPart` (odd m = qm' ≤ M, q | m) and `restPart` (all other terms).

ends.snippet:
theorem e_phase {α x δ : ℝ} {a k₀ : ℤ} {q m' : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hm' : Odd m')
    (h2α : 2 * α = a / q + δ / x + k₀) (r : ℤ) :
    e (α * ((q * m' : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * r + 1)) =
      e ((a + k₀ * q) / 2) * e (δ * ((q * m' : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * x) * (2 * r + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hm'
  have hq0 : (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
    linarith
  have hα : α = (a / q + δ / x + k₀) / 2 := by linarith
  have : α * ((q * (2 * j + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) * (2 * r + 1) =
      (a + k₀ * q) / 2 + δ * ((q * (2 * j + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (2 * x) * (2 * r + 1) +
        (((a + k₀ * q) * (2 * j * r + j + r) : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [hα]; push_cast; field_simp; ring
  rw [this, e_add, e_add, e_intCast, mul_one]

theorem pair_le_half {n r : ℝ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hr : |r| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    1 / (n - r) ^ 2 + 1 / (n + r) ^ 2 ≤ 1 / (n - 1 / 2) ^ 2 + 1 / (n + 1 / 2) ^ 2 := by
  have hr2 : r ^ 2 ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    have := sq_abs r ▸ pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg r) hr 2; linarith
  have h1 : 0 < n - r := by linarith [neg_abs_le r, le_abs_self r]
  have h2 : 0 < n + r := by linarith [neg_abs_le r, le_abs_self r]
  have h3 : 0 < n - 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have h4 : 0 < n + 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have E : ∀ t, 0 < n - t → 0 < n + t →
      1 / (n - t) ^ 2 + 1 / (n + t) ^ 2 = 2 * (n ^ 2 + t ^ 2) / (n ^ 2 - t ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
    intro t ht1 ht2
    have : n ^ 2 - t ^ 2 = (n - t) * (n + t) := by ring
    rw [this]; field_simp; ring
  have e1 := E r h1 h2
  have e2 := E (1 / 2) h3 h4
  rw [show ((1 : ℝ) / 2) ^ 2 = 1 / 4 by norm_num] at e2
  rw [e1, e2]
  have ha : 0 < n ^ 2 - r ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hb : 0 < n ^ 2 - 1 / 4 := by nlinarith
  rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
  -- `(N+a)(N-b)² ≤ (N+b)(N-a)²` with `a = r² ≤ b = 1/4`, `N = n² ≥ 1`.
  have hN : 1 ≤ n ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have key : (n ^ 2 + 1 / 4) * (n ^ 2 - r ^ 2) ^ 2 - (n ^ 2 + r ^ 2) * (n ^ 2 - 1 / 4) ^ 2 =
      (1 / 4 - r ^ 2) * (3 * (n ^ 2) ^ 2 - n ^ 2 * (r ^ 2 + 1 / 4) - r ^ 2 / 4) := by ring
  have : 0 ≤ (1 / 4 - r ^ 2) * (3 * (n ^ 2) ^ 2 - n ^ 2 * (r ^ 2 + 1 / 4) - r ^ 2 / 4) := by
    apply mul_nonneg (by linarith); nlinarith [sq_nonneg r]
  nlinarith

proof_context.conclusion: For n ≥ 1, |r| ≤ 1/2: `1/(n−r)²+1/(n+r)² ≤ 1/(n−1/2)²+1/(n+1/2)²`, by direct algebra.

  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn

  have hn' : (n : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn.ne'
  have hn1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  simp only [hn', neg_eq_zero, ite_false, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast]

theorem norm_Todd_le_minA {α x δ : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x)
    (h2α : 2 * α = a / q + δ / x + k) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {A C : ℝ}

  have hs := sin_sq_two_pi_mul h2α (m : ℝ) ⟨m, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := norm_Todd_le hx hm α
  push_cast at hs ⊢
  unfold minA
  split_ifs with h0
  · exact h1.trans hA
  · have hne : Real.sin (2 * π * m * α) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h; apply h0; rw [← hs, h]; ring

    refine (h2 hne).2.trans ?_
    rw [hs]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hC (sq_nonneg _)

/-- Split `∑_{⌊a⌋ < n ≤ ⌊b⌋} G(n)` (`G ≥ 0`) into blocks `(a + jq, min(a + (j+1)q, b)]`. -/
theorem sum_Ioc_le_blocks {G : ℤ → ℝ} (hG : ∀ n, 0 ≤ G n) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) :
    ∀ (J : ℕ) (a b : ℝ), b ≤ a + J * q →
      ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, G n ≤
        ∑ j ∈ range J, ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a + j * q⌋ ⌊min (a + (j + 1) * q) b⌋, G n := by
  intro J
  induction J with
  | zero =>
    intro a b hab
    simp only [CharP.cast_eq_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] at hab
    rw [Ioc_eq_empty (not_lt.2 (Int.floor_mono hab))]; simp
  | succ J ih =>
    intro a b hab
    rw [sum_range_succ']
    simp only [CharP.cast_eq_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add, one_mul]
    have hq' : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
    have hih := ih (a + q) b (by push_cast at hab; linarith)
    have hrw : ∀ j : ℕ, a + q + j * q = a + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * q := fun j => by push_cast; ring
    have hrw2 : ∀ j : ℕ, a + q + (j + 1) * q = a + (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * q := fun j => by
      push_cast; ring
    simp_rw [hrw, hrw2] at hih
    rcases le_or_gt b (a + q) with hb | hb
    · rw [min_eq_right hb]
      have : ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a + q⌋ ⌊b⌋, G n = 0 := by
        rw [Ioc_eq_empty (not_lt.2 (Int.floor_mono hb))]; simp
      have h0 : 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ range J, ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a + ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * q⌋
          ⌊min (a + (((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * q) b⌋, G n :=
        sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sum_nonneg fun _ _ => hG _
      linarith
    · rw [min_eq_left hb.le]
      have hsplit : ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊b⌋, G n =
          ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a⌋ ⌊a + q⌋, G n + ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊a + q⌋ ⌊b⌋, G n := by
        rw [← sum_union (Finset.disjoint_left.2 fun n h1 h2 => by
          simp only [mem_Ioc] at h1 h2; omega)]
        congr 1
        ext n; simp only [mem_Ioc, mem_union]
        have h1 : ⌊a⌋ ≤ ⌊a + q⌋ := Int.floor_mono (by linarith)
        have h2 : ⌊a + q⌋ ≤ ⌊b⌋ := Int.floor_mono hb.le
        omega
      rw [hsplit]; linarith

proof_context.conclusion: Decomposition of the range into blocks of length `q'`.

theorem sum_odd_mul_log_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) {N : ℕ} {M : ℝ}
    (hM0 : 0 < M) (hNM : (q : ℝ) * N ≤ M) (hMx : M ≤ x / rexp 1) :
    ∑ m' ∈ Icc 1 N, (if Odd m' then ((q : ℝ) * m') * (Real.log x - Real.log (q * m')) else 0) ≤

  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have he : x / rexp 1 ≤ x := div_le_self hx.le (by linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (1:ℝ)])
  have hRHS1 : 0 ≤ M * (Real.log x - Real.log M) :=
    mul_nonneg hM0.le (by linarith [Real.log_le_log hM0 (hMx.trans he)])
  have hRHS2 : 0 ≤ M ^ 2 / (4 * q) * (1 / 2 + Real.log x - Real.log M) :=
    mul_nonneg (by positivity) (by linarith [Real.log_le_log hM0 (hMx.trans he)])
  -- Rewrite as a sum over `i < I`, `m' = 2i + 1`.
  have hodd := sum_Icc_odd_eq' N (fun m' : ℕ => ((q : ℝ) * m') * (Real.log x - Real.log (q * m')))
  rw [hodd]
  set I := (N + 1) / 2
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos I with hI | hI
  · rw [hI, sum_range_zero]; linarith
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ : ∃ K, I = K + 1 := ⟨I - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [hK, sum_range_succ]
  set t : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => (q : ℝ) * ((2 * i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  have ht : ∀ i : ℕ, t i = q + i * (2 * q) := fun i => by simp only [t]; push_cast; ring
  have htK : t K ≤ M := by
    have : 2 * K + 1 ≤ N := by omega
    have : ((2 * K + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast this
    simp only [t]; nlinarith
  have htKx : t K ≤ x / rexp 1 := htK.trans hMx
  have hsub : Set.Icc (q : ℝ) (q + K * (2 * q)) ⊆ Set.Ioc 0 (x / rexp 1) := fun s hs =>
    ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hq0 hs.1, hs.2.trans (by rw [← ht]; exact htKx)⟩
  have hMono := sum_le_of_monotone (F := fun s => s ^ 2 / 2 * (1 / 2 + Real.log x - Real.log s))

    linarith [Real.log_le_log hq0 this]

  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ range K, t i * (Real.log x - Real.log (t i)) ≤

    rw [show M ^ 2 / (4 * q) * (1 / 2 + Real.log x - Real.log M) =

theorem monotoneOn_f₂ (hx : 0 < x) :
    MonotoneOn (fun t => t * (Real.log x - Real.log t)) (Set.Ioc 0 (x / rexp 1)) := by
  refine monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Ioc 0 (x / rexp 1)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact fun t ht => (hasDerivAt_f₂ x ht.1).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  · intro t ht
    rw [interior_Ioc] at ht
    exact (hasDerivAt_f₂ x ht.1).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  · intro t ht
    rw [interior_Ioc] at ht
    rw [(hasDerivAt_f₂ x ht.1).deriv]
    have h1 : Real.log t ≤ Real.log x - 1 := by
      have := Real.log_le_log ht.1 ht.2.le
      rw [Real.log_div hx.ne' (Real.exp_pos 1).ne', Real.log_exp] at this; exact this
    linarith

theorem mul_log_le_inv_e {u : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) : u * (-Real.log u) ≤ 1 / rexp 1 := by

    hu.ne', Real.log_exp] at h
  have : u * (1 / (rexp 1 * u)) = 1 / rexp 1 := by field_simp
  nlinarith

    (hne : Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * (m : ℤ)) ≠ 0) {A B C : ℝ}
    (hA : x / (2 * m) + eta2'L1 / 2 ≤ A) (hB : eta2'L1 / 2 ≤ B) (hC : m / x * (c₀ / 2) ≤ C) :
    ‖ToddG (eta2log (x / m)) α x m‖ ≤
      Real.log (x / m) * min A (C / Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * (m : ℤ)) ^ 2) ∧
    ‖ToddG (eta2log (x / m)) α x m‖ ≤
      Real.log (x / m) * min (B / |Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * (m : ℤ))|)
        (C / Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * (m : ℤ)) ^ 2) := by
  have hmR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hρ : 4 ≤ x / m := by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith)]; linarith
  have hL : 0 ≤ Real.log (x / m) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hsd := smoothData_eta2log hρ
  have hs := sin_sq_two_pi_mul h2α (m : ℝ) ⟨m, by simp⟩
  push_cast at hs hne ⊢
  have habs : |Real.sin (2 * π * m * α)| = |Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * m)| := by
    rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _), sq_abs, sq_abs, hs]
  have hne' : Real.sin (2 * π * m * α) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hne; rw [← abs_eq_zero, ← habs, h, abs_zero]
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hsd.norm_ToddG_le hx hm α
  obtain ⟨h2a, h2b⟩ := h2 hne'
  have hA' : ‖ToddG (eta2log (x / m)) α x m‖ ≤ Real.log (x / m) * A := by
    refine h1.trans ?_
    have : x / (2 * m) * Real.log (x / m) + eta2'L1 * Real.log (x / m) / 2 =
        Real.log (x / m) * (x / (2 * m) + eta2'L1 / 2) := by ring
    rw [this]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA hL
  have hC' : ‖ToddG (eta2log (x / m)) α x m‖ ≤
      Real.log (x / m) * (C / Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * m) ^ 2) := by
    refine h2b.trans ?_; rw [hs]
    have : m / x * (c₀ * Real.log (x / m) / 2) / Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * m) ^ 2 =
        Real.log (x / m) * (m / x * (c₀ / 2) / Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * m) ^ 2) := by ring
    rw [this]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hC (sq_nonneg _)) hL
  have hB' : ‖ToddG (eta2log (x / m)) α x m‖ ≤
      Real.log (x / m) * (B / |Real.sin (π * (a / q + δ / x) * m)|) := by
    refine h2a.trans ?_; rw [habs]

    rw [this]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hB (abs_nonneg _)) hL

theorem dvd_mul_iff_div_gcd {q v u : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) :

  set g := Nat.gcd q v with hgdef
  obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁⟩ := Nat.gcd_dvd_left q v
  obtain ⟨v₁, hv₁⟩ := Nat.gcd_dvd_right q v
  have hq1eq : q / g = q₁ := by
    have : q / g = g * q₁ / g := congrArg (· / g) hq₁
    rw [this, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hg]
  have hv1eq : v / g = v₁ := by
    have : v / g = g * v₁ / g := congrArg (· / g) hv₁
    rw [this, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hg]
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime q₁ v₁ := by
    have := Nat.coprime_div_gcd_div_gcd (m := q) (n := v) hg
    rwa [← hgdef, hq1eq, hv1eq] at this
  rw [hq1eq]
  have e : (q ∣ v * u) = (g * q₁ ∣ g * (v₁ * u)) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← hq₁, ← hv₁]
  rw [e]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (Nat.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_left hg h)
  · intro h
    exact Nat.mul_dvd_mul_left _ (Dvd.dvd.mul_left h _)

theorem norm_eta2hat_le_minInv (δ : ℝ) : ‖eta2hat (-(δ / 2))‖ ≤ minInv c₀ (π * δ) := by

  · exact norm_eta2hat_le_one _

    congr 1; ring

/-- [H, p. 73]: `∑_{u ≤ K, u odd, q | u} u ≤ K²/4q + 3K/4` for `q` odd. -/
theorem sum_odd_dvd_le {q : ℕ} (hq : Odd q) (K : ℕ) :
    ∑ u ∈ Icc 1 K, (if Odd u ∧ q ∣ u then (u : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (K : ℝ) ^ 2 / (4 * q) + 3 * K / 4 := by
  have hq1 : 1 ≤ q := hq.pos
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  have h := sum_dvd_reindex hq1 (K : ℝ) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (fun u => (u : ℝ))
  rw [Nat.floor_natCast] at h
  rw [h]
  set N := ⌊(K : ℝ) / q⌋₊
  have hN : (N : ℝ) ≤ K / q := Nat.floor_le (by positivity)
  have hodd : ∀ w, Odd (q * w) ↔ Odd w := fun w => by
    rw [Nat.odd_mul]; exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hq, h⟩⟩
  have e : ∑ w ∈ Icc 1 N, (if Odd (q * w) then ((q * w : ℕ) : ℝ) else 0) =
      q * ∑ w ∈ Icc 1 N, (if Odd w then (w : ℝ) else 0) := by
    rw [mul_sum]; refine sum_congr rfl fun w _ => ?_
    by_cases ho : Odd w
    · rw [if_pos ((hodd w).2 ho), if_pos ho]; push_cast; ring
    · rw [if_neg (fun h => ho ((hodd w).1 h)), if_neg ho, mul_zero]
  rw [e]
  have hK0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ K := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N with h0 | hpos
  · rw [h0]; simp; positivity
  have hqK : (q : ℝ) ≤ K := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ N := by exact_mod_cast hpos
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hq0] at hN; nlinarith
  calc (q : ℝ) * ∑ w ∈ Icc 1 N, (if Odd w then (w : ℝ) else 0)
      ≤ q * (((N : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 / 4) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_odd_le N) hq0.le
    _ ≤ q * ((K / q + 1) ^ 2 / 4) := by gcongr
    _ = (K : ℝ) ^ 2 / (4 * q) + K / 2 + q / 4 := by field_simp; ring
    _ ≤ _ := by linarith

proof_context.conclusion: For odd `q` and natural `K`, `Σ_{u≤K, u odd, q∣u} u ≤ K²/(4q) + 3K/4`.

have hterm : ∀ i ∈ range K, Real.log (min (R + (((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * q) D) *
      (P1 * (1 / (R + ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * q)) +
        2 * q * √(c₀ * c₁) / π * √(1 + q / (R + ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * q))) ≤
      (P1 * Real.log D + Bc * q * q + Bc * q * (q / 2) * Real.log D) * (1 / y i) +
        Bc * q * Real.log (y i) := by
    intro i _
    have hyi := hy0 i
    have hyR : R ≤ y i := by simp only [y]; have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * q := by positivity
                             linarith
    have hyq : R + (((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * q = y i + q := by simp only [y]; ring
    rw [hyq]
    change Real.log (min (y i + q) D) * (P1 * (1 / y i) + 2 * q * √(c₀ * c₁) / π * √(1 + q / y i)) ≤ _
    set W := Real.log (min (y i + q) D)
    have hW0 : 0 ≤ W := Real.log_nonneg (le_min (by linarith) hD1)
    have hWD : W ≤ Real.log D := Real.log_le_log (lt_min (by linarith) hD0) (min_le_right _ _)
    have hWy : W ≤ Real.log (y i) + q * (1 / y i) := by
      have h1 : W ≤ Real.log (y i + q) :=
        Real.log_le_log (lt_min (by linarith) hD0) (min_le_left _ _)
      have h2 : Real.log ((y i + q) / y i) ≤ (y i + q) / y i - 1 :=
        Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity)
      rw [Real.log_div (by linarith) hyi.ne'] at h2
      have e : (y i + q) / y i - 1 = q * (1 / y i) := by field_simp; ring
      linarith
    have hs : √(1 + q / y i) ≤ 1 + q / y i / 2 := by
      rw [Real.sqrt_le_iff]
      refine ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (q / y i)]
    have e2 : W * √(1 + q / y i) ≤ Real.log (y i) + q * (1 / y i) + q / 2 * Real.log D * (1 / y i) := by
      calc W * √(1 + q / y i) ≤ W * (1 + q / y i / 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hW0
        _ = W + W * (q / 2 * (1 / y i)) := by ring
        _ ≤ (Real.log (y i) + q * (1 / y i)) + Real.log D * (q / 2 * (1 / y i)) :=
            add_le_add hWy (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hWD (by positivity))
        _ = _ := by ring
    have e : 2 * q * √(c₀ * c₁) / π = Bc * q := by simp only [Bc]; ring
    rw [e]
    calc W * (P1 * (1 / y i) + Bc * q * √(1 + q / y i))
        = P1 * (1 / y i) * W + Bc * q * (W * √(1 + q / y i)) := by ring
      _ ≤ P1 * (1 / y i) * Real.log D +
          Bc * q * (Real.log (y i) + q * (1 / y i) + q / 2 * Real.log D * (1 / y i)) :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hWD (by have := hy0 i; positivity))

      refine sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_

      rw [Real.log_div hD0.ne' hR0.ne']

/-- Weighted range (R3) (cf. [H, (4.61)–(4.62)]), general form: for `1 ≤ R < D`, with
`c₁ = 1 + |η'|₁/(x/D)`,
`∑_{R < m ≤ D} log m |T_{m,∘}| ≤ (3c₁/2) x (log(R+q)/R + (log D/q) log(D/R)) +
(2√(c₀c₁)/π)(√(1+q/R) q log(R+q) + D(log D - 1) - R(log R - 1) + 2q log(D/R) + (q/2) log D log(D/R))`. -/
theorem sum_R3W' {α x δ Q : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hx : 0 < x) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ)) (h2α : 2 * α = a / q + δ / x + k) (hqQ : (q : ℝ) ≤ Q)
    (hδ : |δ / x| * (q * Q) ≤ 1) {R D : ℝ} (hR1 : 1 ≤ R) (hRD : R < D) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊R⌋ ⌊D⌋, Real.log n * Tn α x n ≤
      3 * (1 + eta2'L1 / (x / D)) / 2 * x *
          (Real.log (R + q) / R + Real.log D / q * Real.log (D / R)) +
        2 * √(c₀ * (1 + eta2'L1 / (x / D))) / π *
          (q * √(1 + q / R) * Real.log (R + q) + (D * (Real.log D - 1) - R * (Real.log R - 1)) +
            2 * q * Real.log (D / R) + q / 2 * Real.log D * Real.log (D / R)) := by

proof_context.conclusion: General weighted range (R3) bound for 1 <= R < D (statement).

have hW2 : ∑ n ∈ Ioc ⌊M⌋ ⌊D⌋, Real.log n * Tn α x n ≤

        have h2 : x / (ε * Qr / (1 + ε)) = (1 + ε) / ε * (x / Qr) := by field_simp

      have hP1 : x * (Real.log (M + q') / M + Real.log D / q' * Real.log (D / M)) ≤
          (2 * Real.log (5 * D) + (1 + ε) / ε * Real.log D * logPlus (2 * D / Qr)) * (x / Q₀) := by
        have e : x * (Real.log (M + q') / M + Real.log D / q' * Real.log (D / M)) =
            (x / M) * Real.log (M + q') + (x / q') * (Real.log D * Real.log (D / M)) := by
          field_simp
        rw [e]
        have h1 : (x / M) * Real.log (M + q') ≤ (2 * (x / Q₀)) * Real.log (5 * D) :=
          mul_le_mul hxM hMq' hlMq (by positivity)
        have h2 : (x / q') * (Real.log D * Real.log (D / M)) ≤

          mul_le_mul hxq' (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogeq hlogD) (by positivity) (by positivity)
        linarith
      have hP2 : q' * √(1 + q' / M) * Real.log (M + q') + 2 * q' * Real.log (D / M) +
            q' / 2 * Real.log D * Real.log (D / M) ≤

            (2 + Real.log D / 2) * logPlus (2 * D / Qr)) := by
        have h1 : √(1 + q' / M) * Real.log (M + q') ≤ √(3 + 2 * ε) * Real.log (5 * D) :=
          mul_le_mul hsqrt hMq' hlMq (by positivity)

            (2 + Real.log D / 2) * logPlus (2 * D / Qr) := by
          have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlogeq (show 0 ≤ 2 + Real.log D / 2 by positivity)
          linarith
        have hX : 0 ≤ √(3 + 2 * ε) * Real.log (5 * D) + (2 + Real.log D / 2) * logPlus (2 * D / Qr) := by
          positivity
        calc q' * √(1 + q' / M) * Real.log (M + q') + 2 * q' * Real.log (D / M) +
              q' / 2 * Real.log D * Real.log (D / M)
            = q' * (√(1 + q' / M) * Real.log (M + q') +
                (2 * Real.log (D / M) + Real.log D / 2 * Real.log (D / M))) := by ring
          _ ≤ q' * (√(3 + 2 * ε) * Real.log (5 * D) + (2 + Real.log D / 2) * logPlus (2 * D / Qr)) :=

          _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hq'min hX

      have hP1' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP1 hk1
      have hP2' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP2 hBc
      linarith

  have hne : ∏ p ∈ P.primeFactors, (1 - 1 / (p : ℝ) ^ 2) ≠ 0 :=

/-- **`g₂(x) = ∑_{d ≤ N} μ(d) (∑_{r ≤ N, d ∣ r} f(r))²`**, `N = ⌊x⌋`. -/
theorem g2_eq_sum_dvd (x : ℝ) :
    g2 x = ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊, (μ d : ℝ) * (∑ r ∈ (Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊).filter (d ∣ ·), fo r) ^ 2 := by
  set N := ⌊x⌋₊
  unfold g2
  simp_rw [g2_term_eq]
  -- `[coprime] = ∑_{d ∣ gcd} μ(d)`
  have hcop : ∀ r₁ r₂ : ℕ, (if Nat.Coprime r₁ r₂ then fo r₁ * fo r₂ else 0) =
      ∑ d ∈ (Nat.gcd r₁ r₂).divisors, (μ d : ℝ) * (fo r₁ * fo r₂) := by
    intro r₁ r₂
    rw [← sum_mul, g2_sum_moebius_divisors]
    simp only [Nat.Coprime]; split_ifs <;> simp
  simp_rw [hcop]
  -- swap: `∑_{r₁, r₂} ∑_{d ∣ (r₁, r₂)} = ∑_d ∑_{d ∣ r₁} ∑_{d ∣ r₂}`
  have hswap : ∀ r₁ ∈ Icc 1 N, ∀ r₂ ∈ Icc 1 N,
      ∑ d ∈ (Nat.gcd r₁ r₂).divisors, (μ d : ℝ) * (fo r₁ * fo r₂) =
        ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 N, if d ∣ r₁ ∧ d ∣ r₂ then (μ d : ℝ) * (fo r₁ * fo r₂) else 0 := by
    intro r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂
    rw [← sum_filter]
    refine sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
    ext d
    simp only [Nat.mem_divisors, mem_filter, mem_Icc, Nat.dvd_gcd_iff]
    have h1 := (mem_Icc.1 hr₁).1; have h2 := (mem_Icc.1 hr₁).2
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hd1, hd2⟩, hg⟩
      have hpos : 0 < d := Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hd1 (by omega)
      exact ⟨⟨hpos, (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd1).trans h2⟩, hd1, hd2⟩
    · rintro ⟨-, hd1, hd2⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hd1, hd2⟩, (Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left _ (by omega)).ne'⟩
  rw [sum_congr rfl fun r₁ hr₁ => sum_congr rfl fun r₂ hr₂ => hswap r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂]
  have hin : ∀ r₁ ∈ Icc 1 N, (∑ r₂ ∈ Icc 1 N, ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 N,
      if d ∣ r₁ ∧ d ∣ r₂ then (μ d : ℝ) * (fo r₁ * fo r₂) else 0) =
      ∑ d ∈ Icc 1 N, ∑ r₂ ∈ Icc 1 N, if d ∣ r₁ ∧ d ∣ r₂ then (μ d : ℝ) * (fo r₁ * fo r₂) else 0 :=
    fun _ _ => sum_comm
  rw [sum_congr rfl hin, sum_comm]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun d _ => ?_
  rw [sum_filter, sq, sum_mul_sum, mul_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun r₁ _ => ?_
  rw [mul_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun r₂ _ => ?_
  by_cases h1 : d ∣ r₁ <;> by_cases h2 : d ∣ r₂ <;> simp [h1, h2]

theorem abs_m_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) {u : ℕ} (hu : 1 ≤ u) (hux : (u : ℝ) ≤ x) :
    |∑ n ∈ Icc 1 ⌊x / u⌋₊, (μ n : ℝ) / n| ≤
      0.03 * (u : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) / Real.log x + √2 * √(u : ℝ) / √x := by
  have hu0 : (0 : ℝ) < u := by exact_mod_cast hu
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hlx : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos hx
  have hy1 : 1 ≤ x / u := by rw [le_div_iff₀ hu0]; linarith
  have hA0 : 0 ≤ 0.03 * (u : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) / Real.log x := by positivity
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ √2 * √(u : ℝ) / √x := by positivity
  by_cases h : 11815 ≤ x / u
  · have hR := TernaryGoldbach.Prelim.ramare_moebius h
    have hw : 9 ≤ Real.log (x / u) := le_trans log_11815_ge9 (Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) h)
    have hv : 0 ≤ Real.log u := Real.log_natCast_nonneg u
    have hsplit : Real.log x = Real.log u + Real.log (x / u) := by
      rw [Real.log_div hx0.ne' hu0.ne']; ring
    have hexp : 1 + Real.log u / 9 ≤ (u : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) := by
      rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hu0]
      have := Real.add_one_le_exp (Real.log u * (1 / 9))
      linarith
    have key : Real.log x ≤ (u : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) * Real.log (x / u) := by
      rw [hsplit]
      have : (1 + Real.log u / 9) * Real.log (x / u) ≤
          (u : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) * Real.log (x / u) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hexp (by linarith)
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hv (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (x / u) - 9)]
    have hw0 : 0 < Real.log (x / u) := by linarith
    calc _ ≤ 0.03 / Real.log (x / u) := hR

        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hw0 hlx]
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left key (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 0.03)
        linarith

      _ = √2 * √(u : ℝ) / √x := by

theorem fo_sq_Sd_sq_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) {d : ℕ} (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) :

  have hg2 := gsq_nonneg d
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd d with he | ho
  · have : fo d = 0 := by simp [fo, Nat.not_odd_iff_even.2 he]
    rw [this]
    have : 0 ≤ 0.015913 / Real.log x ^ 2 * gmain (1 / 9) d + 527.85 / x * gsq d := by positivity
    simpa using this
  have hS := abs_Sd_le hx hd1
  set A := ⌊x⌋₊ / d
  have hP1 := PS9_le ho A
  have hP2 := PSh_le ho A
  set R1 := ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, rho (1 / 9) p
  set R2 := ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, rho (1 / 2) p
  set α := 0.03 * (d : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) / Real.log x * (2.9733 * R1) with hα
  set β := √2 * √(d : ℝ) / √x * (11.4874 * R2) with hβ
  have hab : |Sd d A| ≤ α + β :=
    hS.trans (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP1 (by positivity))
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP2 (by positivity)))
  have hsq : Sd d A ^ 2 ≤ 2 * α ^ 2 + 2 * β ^ 2 := by

      _ ≤ 2 * α ^ 2 + 2 * β ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (α - β)]

/-- One term of `∑_d f(d)² S_d²`. -/
theorem fo_sq_Sd_sq_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) {d : ℕ} (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) :
    fo d ^ 2 * Sd d (⌊x⌋₊ / d) ^ 2 ≤
      0.015913 / Real.log x ^ 2 * gmain (1 / 9) d + 527.85 / x * gsq d := by
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hlx : 0 < Real.log x := Real.log_pos hx
  have hg1 := gmain_nonneg (1 / 9) d
  have hg2 := gsq_nonneg d
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd d with he | ho
  · have : fo d = 0 := by simp [fo, Nat.not_odd_iff_even.2 he]
    rw [this]
    have : 0 ≤ 0.015913 / Real.log x ^ 2 * gmain (1 / 9) d + 527.85 / x * gsq d := by positivity
    simpa using this
  have hS := abs_Sd_le hx hd1
  set A := ⌊x⌋₊ / d
  have hP1 := PS9_le ho A
  have hP2 := PSh_le ho A
  set R1 := ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, rho (1 / 9) p
  set R2 := ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, rho (1 / 2) p
  set α := 0.03 * (d : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 9) / Real.log x * (2.9733 * R1) with hα
  set β := √2 * √(d : ℝ) / √x * (11.4874 * R2) with hβ
  have hab : |Sd d A| ≤ α + β :=
    hS.trans (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP1 (by positivity))
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hP2 (by positivity)))
  have hsq : Sd d A ^ 2 ≤ 2 * α ^ 2 + 2 * β ^ 2 := by
    calc Sd d A ^ 2 = |Sd d A| ^ 2 := (sq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ (α + β) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) hab 2
      _ ≤ 2 * α ^ 2 + 2 * β ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (α - β)]
  have hβ2 : β ^ 2 = 2 * d / x * (11.4874 * R2) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hβ, mul_pow, div_pow, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num), Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _),
      Real.sq_sqrt hx0.le]
  calc fo d ^ 2 * Sd d A ^ 2 ≤ fo d ^ 2 * (2 * α ^ 2 + 2 * β ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = 2 * (0.03 * 2.9733) ^ 2 / Real.log x ^ 2 * gmain (1 / 9) d +
        2 * (2 * 11.4874 ^ 2) / x * gsq d := by
        rw [hβ2, hα, gmain, gsq_apply]
        field_simp
        ring
    _ ≤ 0.015913 / Real.log x ^ 2 * gmain (1 / 9) d + 527.85 / x * gsq d := by
        gcongr
        · norm_num
        · norm_num

/-- The separation of the angles `a/q + b/r + u` of [H, (5.40)–(5.41)]: for `r, r' ≤ R` coprime
to `q`, `(b, r) = (b', r') = 1`, `|u| ≤ υ`, `qR²(ν + υ) ≤ 1`, `ν + υ ≤ 1/q`, the difference
`t = A/q + b/r - b'/r' + u` has `‖t‖ ≥ ν`, unless `q | A`, `r = r'`, `b = b'` (where we assume
`|u| ≥ ν`). -/
theorem sep_triples {q r r' b b' : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hr' : 1 ≤ r')
    (hrq : Nat.Coprime r q) (hr'q : Nat.Coprime r' q) (hb : b < r) (hb' : b' < r')
    (hbr : Nat.Coprime r b) (hb'r : Nat.Coprime r' b') {A : ℤ} {u ν υ R : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν)
    (hu : |u| ≤ υ) (hRr : (r : ℝ) ≤ R) (hRr' : (r' : ℝ) ≤ R) (hR : q * R ^ 2 * (ν + υ) ≤ 1)
    (hνυ : ν + υ ≤ 1 / q) (hcase : (q : ℤ) ∣ A → r = r' → b = b' → ν ≤ |u|) :
    ν ≤ |(A / q + b / r - b' / r' + u : ℝ) - round (A / q + b / r - b' / r' + u : ℝ)| := by
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hr'0 : (0 : ℝ) < r' := by exact_mod_cast hr'
  set M : ℤ := A * r * r' + q * (b * r' - b' * r)
  have hM : (A / q + b / r - b' / r' : ℝ) = M / (q * r * r') := by
    simp only [M]; push_cast; field_simp; ring
  apply le_dist_round_of_forall
  intro n
  by_cases hdiv : ((q * r * r' : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ M
  · -- Then `r = r'`, `b = b'`, `q ∣ A`.
    have hrq' : IsCoprime (r : ℤ) q := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hrq
    have hr'q' : IsCoprime (r' : ℤ) q := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hr'q
    have hbr' : IsCoprime (r : ℤ) b := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hbr
    have hb'r' : IsCoprime (r' : ℤ) b' := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hb'r
    have h1 : (r : ℤ) ∣ r' := by
      have : (r : ℤ) ∣ M := dvd_trans (⟨(q : ℤ) * r', by push_cast; ring⟩ : (r : ℤ) ∣ ((q * r * r' : ℕ) : ℤ)) hdiv
      have h2 : (r : ℤ) ∣ q * (b * r') := by
        have e : (q : ℤ) * (b * r') = M - r * (A * r' - q * b') := by simp only [M]; ring
        rw [e]; exact dvd_sub this (dvd_mul_right _ _)
      exact hbr'.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (hrq'.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h2)
    have h1' : (r' : ℤ) ∣ r := by
      have : (r' : ℤ) ∣ M := dvd_trans (⟨(q : ℤ) * r, by push_cast; ring⟩ : (r' : ℤ) ∣ ((q * r * r' : ℕ) : ℤ)) hdiv
      have h2 : (r' : ℤ) ∣ q * (b' * r) := by
        have e : (q : ℤ) * (b' * r) = r' * (A * r + q * b) - M := by simp only [M]; ring
        rw [e]; exact dvd_sub (dvd_mul_right _ _) this
      exact hb'r'.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (hr'q'.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left h2)
    have hrr : r = r' := by
      have := Int.dvd_antisymm (by positivity) (by positivity) h1 h1'
      exact_mod_cast this
    subst hrr
    have h3 : ((q * r : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ A * r + q * (b - b') := by
      have e : M = r * (A * r + q * (b - b')) := by simp only [M]; ring
      rw [e] at hdiv
      have : ((q * r * r : ℕ) : ℤ) = r * ((q * r : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [this] at hdiv
      exact (Int.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_left (by positivity) hdiv)
    have h4 : (r : ℤ) ∣ b - b' := by
      have : (r : ℤ) ∣ q * (b - b') := by
        have hr3 : (r : ℤ) ∣ A * r + q * (b - b') :=
          dvd_trans (⟨(q : ℤ), by push_cast; ring⟩ : (r : ℤ) ∣ ((q * r : ℕ) : ℤ)) h3
        have e : (q : ℤ) * (b - b') = (A * r + q * (b - b')) - A * r := by ring
        rw [e]; exact dvd_sub hr3 (dvd_mul_left _ _)
      exact hrq'.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left this
    have hbb : b = b' := by
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h4
      have : c = 0 := by
        by_contra hc0
        have : (r : ℤ) ≤ |(b : ℤ) - b'| := by
          rw [hc, abs_mul]; nlinarith [abs_nonneg (r : ℤ), Int.one_le_abs hc0, abs_of_pos (show (0:ℤ) < r by positivity)]
        have : |(b : ℤ) - b'| < r := by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> omega

      rw [this, mul_zero] at hc; omega
    subst hbb
    have h5 : (q : ℤ) ∣ A := by
      have e : A * r + q * (b - b) = A * r := by ring
      rw [e] at h3
      have : ((q * r : ℕ) : ℤ) = q * r := by push_cast; ring
      rw [this] at h3
      exact Int.dvd_of_mul_dvd_mul_right (by positivity) h3

/-- The large sieve (optimal form) for `S(β)`: for `δ`-separated points (`0 < δ ≤ 1`),
`∑_r |S(β_r)|² ≤ (W - W' + δ⁻¹) ∑ (log p)²`. -/
theorem large_sieve_primes {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (β : ι → ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hsep : ∀ r ∈ s, ∀ r' ∈ s, r ≠ r' → δ ≤ |(β r - β r') - round (β r - β r')|)
    {W' W : ℝ} (hW' : 0 ≤ W') :
    ∑ r ∈ s, ‖primeExpSum W' W (β r)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (W - W' + δ⁻¹) * logSqSum W' W := by
  rcases lt_or_ge ⌊W'⌋₊ ⌊W⌋₊ with hlt | hge
  · set M := ⌊W'⌋₊
    set N := ⌊W⌋₊ - M
    have hMN : M + N = ⌊W⌋₊ := by omega
    set a : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => if n.Prime then (Real.log n : ℂ) else 0
    have hS : ∀ t, primeExpSum W' W t = ∑ n ∈ Ioc M (M + N), a n * e (t * n) := by
      intro t
      rw [primeExpSum, hMN, sum_filter]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
      simp only [a]; split_ifs <;> simp
    have hL : logSqSum W' W = ∑ n ∈ Ioc M (M + N), ‖a n‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [logSqSum, hMN, sum_filter]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
      simp only [a]; split_ifs
      · rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      · simp
    simp_rw [hS]
    rw [hL]
    refine (Prelim.large_sieve_opt s β hδ hδ1 hsep M N a).trans ?_
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hW0 : 0 ≤ W := by
      by_contra h; push Not at h
      have : ⌊W⌋₊ = 0 := Nat.floor_eq_zero.2 (by linarith)
      omega
    have h1 : (⌊W⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ W := Nat.floor_le hW0
    have h2 : W' < (⌊W'⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one W'
    have hN : (N : ℝ) = ⌊W⌋₊ - ⌊W'⌋₊ := by
      simp only [N, M]; rw [Nat.cast_sub hlt.le]
    rw [hN]; linarith
  · have hempty : Ioc ⌊W'⌋₊ ⌊W⌋₊ = ∅ := Ioc_eq_empty (not_lt.2 hge)
    simp [primeExpSum, logSqSum, hempty]

proof_context.conclusion: Large sieve in N+δ⁻¹ form for primes, δ-separated points.

/-- **Montgomery's inequality** (case `ω(p) = 1`): for squarefree `r` and `a(n)` supported on
`n` coprime to `r`, `|S(α)|² ≤ φ(r) ∑_{b < r, (b,r)=1} |S(α + b/r)|²`. -/
theorem montgomery_ineq {r : ℕ} (hr : Squarefree r) (s : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hs : ∀ n ∈ s, Nat.Coprime n r) (α : ℝ) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e (α * n)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (Nat.totient r : ℝ) * ∑ b ∈ (range r).filter r.Coprime,
        ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n)‖ ^ 2 := by
  have hr1 : 1 ≤ r := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by rintro rfl; exact not_squarefree_zero hr)
  set T := (range r).filter r.Coprime
  have hsum : ∑ b ∈ T, ∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n) =
      (μ r : ℂ) * ∑ n ∈ s, a n * e (α * n) := by
    rw [sum_comm, mul_sum]
    refine sum_congr rfl fun n hn => ?_
    have : ∀ b ∈ T, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n) = a n * e (α * n) * e (b * n / r) := by
      intro b _; rw [mul_assoc, ← e_add]; congr 2; ring
    rw [sum_congr rfl this, ← mul_sum, ramanujan_coprime r n hr1 (hs n hn)]
    ring
  have hμ : ‖(μ r : ℂ)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [Complex.norm_intCast]; exact_mod_cast ArithmeticFunction.abs_moebius_eq_one_of_squarefree hr
  have h1 : ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e (α * n)‖ ≤ ∑ b ∈ T, ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n)‖ := by
    have := norm_sum_le T (fun b => ∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n))
    rw [hsum, norm_mul, hμ, one_mul] at this; exact this
  have h2 := sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq (s := T) (f := fun b => ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n)‖)
  have hcard : (#T : ℝ) = Nat.totient r := by rw [Nat.totient_eq_card_coprime]
  rw [hcard] at h2
  calc ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e (α * n)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ b ∈ T, ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e ((α + b / r) * n)‖) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h1 2
    _ ≤ _ := h2

proof_context.conclusion: Montgomery's inequality (ω(p)=1) for coefficients supported on n coprime to squarefree r.

theorem log_le_harmonic_floor (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    Real.log y ≤ harmonic ⌊y⌋₊ := by
  by_cases h0 : y = 0
  · simp [h0]
  · calc
      _ ≤ Real.log ↑(Nat.floor y + 1) := ?_
      _ ≤ _ := log_add_one_le_harmonic _
    gcongr
    apply (Nat.le_ceil y).trans
    norm_cast

proof_context.conclusion: log y ≤ ∑_{d ≤ ⌊y⌋} 1/d (harmonic ⌊y⌋) for all real y ≥ 0.

theorem sep_odd {α Q : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ))
    (hα : |2 * α - a / q - k| ≤ 1 / (q * Q)) (hQ : 0 < Q) {m m' : ℤ} (hm : Odd m) (hm' : Odd m')
    (hne : m ≠ m') {K : ℝ} (hK : |((m - m' : ℤ) : ℝ)| / 2 ≤ K) (hKq : K < q) :
    1 / q - K / (q * Q) ≤ |(α * m - α * m') - round (α * m - α * m')| := by
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j : ℤ, m - m' = 2 * j := by
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hm; obtain ⟨u', hu'⟩ := hm'; exact ⟨u - u', by omega⟩
  have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hjK : (|j| : ℝ) ≤ K := by
    rw [hj] at hK; push_cast at hK; rw [abs_mul] at hK; norm_num at hK; exact_mod_cast hK
  have hjq : |j| < q := by exact_mod_cast hjK.trans_lt hKq
  have e : α * m - α * m' = 2 * α * j := by
    have : (m : ℝ) - m' = 2 * j := by exact_mod_cast hj
    linear_combination α * this
  rw [e]
  refine le_trans ?_ (dist_two_alpha_mul hq hcop hα hQ hj0 hjq)
  have : (|j| : ℝ) / (q * Q) ≤ K / (q * Q) := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hjK (by positivity)
  push_cast at this ⊢; linarith

proof_context.conclusion: For odd m != m' with |m-m'|/2 <= K < q, the distance of alpha(m-m') to the nearest integer is at least 1/q - K/(qQ).

/-- The large sieve (optimal form) for `S(β)`: for `δ`-separated points (`0 < δ ≤ 1`),
`∑_r |S(β_r)|² ≤ (W - W' + δ⁻¹) ∑ (log p)²`. -/
theorem large_sieve_primes {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (β : ι → ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (hsep : ∀ r ∈ s, ∀ r' ∈ s, r ≠ r' → δ ≤ |(β r - β r') - round (β r - β r')|)
    {W' W : ℝ} (hW' : 0 ≤ W') :
    ∑ r ∈ s, ‖primeExpSum W' W (β r)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (W - W' + δ⁻¹) * logSqSum W' W := by
  rcases lt_or_ge ⌊W'⌋₊ ⌊W⌋₊ with hlt | hge
  · set M := ⌊W'⌋₊
    set N := ⌊W⌋₊ - M
    have hMN : M + N = ⌊W⌋₊ := by omega
    set a : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => if n.Prime then (Real.log n : ℂ) else 0
    have hS : ∀ t, primeExpSum W' W t = ∑ n ∈ Ioc M (M + N), a n * e (t * n) := by
      intro t
      rw [primeExpSum, hMN, sum_filter]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
      simp only [a]; split_ifs <;> simp
    have hL : logSqSum W' W = ∑ n ∈ Ioc M (M + N), ‖a n‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [logSqSum, hMN, sum_filter]
      refine sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
      simp only [a]; split_ifs
      · rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      · simp
    simp_rw [hS]
    rw [hL]
    refine (Prelim.large_sieve_opt s β hδ hδ1 hsep M N a).trans ?_
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (sum_nonneg fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
    have hW0 : 0 ≤ W := by
      by_contra h; push Not at h
      have : ⌊W⌋₊ = 0 := Nat.floor_eq_zero.2 (by linarith)
      omega
    have h1 : (⌊W⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ W := Nat.floor_le hW0
    have h2 : W' < (⌊W'⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one W'
    have hN : (N : ℝ) = ⌊W⌋₊ - ⌊W'⌋₊ := by
      simp only [N, M]; rw [Nat.cast_sub hlt.le]
    rw [hN]; linarith
  · have hempty : Ioc ⌊W'⌋₊ ⌊W⌋₊ = ∅ := Ioc_eq_empty (not_lt.2 hge)
    simp [primeExpSum, logSqSum, hempty]

proof_context.conclusion: Large sieve for prime sums over delta-separated points: sum <= (W-W'+delta^-1) sum (log p)^2.

theorem lemma_5_2_3_c {α Q : ℝ} {a k : ℤ} {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hcop : IsCoprime a (q : ℤ))
    (hα : |2 * α - a / q - k| ≤ 1 / (q * Q)) {ϱ ρ : ℝ} (hϱ : 0 ≤ ϱ) (hϱ1 : ϱ ≤ 1) (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ)
    (hϱρ : ϱ * ρ < 1) (hqρ : (q : ℝ) ≤ ρ * Q) {W' W : ℝ} (hW' : 0 ≤ W') {A₀ A₁ : ℝ}
    (hA : A₁ - A₀ ≤ 2 * ϱ * q) :
    oddSqSum α W' W A₀ A₁ ≤ (W - W' + q / (1 - ϱ * ρ)) * logSqSum W' W := by
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hQ : 0 < Q := by
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hρ with h | h
    · rw [← h] at hqρ; linarith
    · nlinarith
  rw [oddSqSum, ← sum_filter]
  have h1ϱρ : 0 < 1 - ϱ * ρ := by linarith
  have hls := large_sieve_primes ((Ioc ⌊A₀⌋ ⌊A₁⌋).filter Odd) (fun m : ℤ => α * m)
    (δ := (1 - ϱ * ρ) / q) (W' := W') (W := W) (by positivity) (by
      rw [div_le_one hq0]; have : 0 ≤ ϱ * ρ := by positivity
      have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hq
      linarith) (by
      intro m hm m' hm' hne
      rw [mem_filter, mem_Ioc] at hm hm'
      have hlt : ((|m - m'| : ℤ) : ℝ) < A₁ - A₀ := by
        have h1 : (⌊A₁⌋ : ℝ) ≤ A₁ := Int.floor_le _
        have h2 : A₀ < (⌊A₀⌋ : ℝ) + 1 := Int.lt_floor_add_one _
        have : |m - m'| ≤ ⌊A₁⌋ - ⌊A₀⌋ - 1 := by rw [abs_le]; omega
        have : ((|m - m'| : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ ⌊A₁⌋ - ⌊A₀⌋ - 1 := by exact_mod_cast this
        linarith
      have hdiff : |((m - m' : ℤ) : ℝ)| / 2 ≤ ϱ * q := by
        rw [← Int.cast_abs]; linarith
      have hsep := sep_odd hq hcop hα hQ hm.2 hm'.2 hne (K := |((m - m' : ℤ) : ℝ)| / 2) le_rfl (by
        have : ϱ * q ≤ q := by nlinarith
        rw [← Int.cast_abs]; linarith)
      refine le_trans ?_ hsep
      have h5 : |((m - m' : ℤ) : ℝ)| / 2 / (q * Q) ≤ ϱ * q / (q * Q) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hdiff (by positivity)
      have : ϱ * q / (q * Q) ≤ ϱ * ρ / q := by
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hq0]
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqρ (show 0 ≤ ϱ * q by positivity)
        nlinarith
      have e : (1 - ϱ * ρ) / q = 1 / q - ϱ * ρ / q := by ring
      linarith) hW'
  rwa [inv_div] at hls

proof_context.conclusion: For odd m, with A1-A0 <= 2*varrho*q and q <= rho*Q, applies the large sieve once without splitting: sum <= (W-W'+q/(1-varrho*rho)) sum (log p)^2.

theorem frac_sep {q r r' b b' : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hr' : 1 ≤ r')
    (hrq : Nat.Coprime r q) (hr'q : Nat.Coprime r' q) (hb : b < r) (hb' : b' < r')
    (hbr : Nat.Coprime r b) (hb'r : Nat.Coprime r' b') {A : ℤ}
    (hne : ¬ ((q : ℤ) ∣ A ∧ r = r' ∧ b = b')) (u : ℝ) :
    1 / ((q : ℝ) * r * r') - |u| ≤
      |(A / q + b / r - b' / r' + u : ℝ) - round (A / q + b / r - b' / r' + u : ℝ)| := by

proof_context.conclusion: For q-coprime r, r' and reduced b/r, b'/r', the distance of A/q + b/r - b'/r' + u to the nearest integer is at least 1/(qrr') - |u| unless the angles coincide.

ends.snippet:

      obtain ⟨⟨hm, hr, _⟩, hb, hbr⟩ := ht

        obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hodd _ hm; obtain ⟨u', hu'⟩ := hodd _ hm'; exact ⟨u - u', by omega⟩
      have hjq : |j| < q := by

      set ε := 2 * α - a / q - k

        linear_combination α * this

        have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) < t'.2.1 := by exact_mod_cast hr1'

        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hrR' (by positivity)
      have h2 : |(j : ℝ) * ε| ≤ 1 / Q := by
        rw [abs_mul]
        have hjq' : |(j : ℝ)| ≤ q - 1 := by
          have : |j| ≤ q - 1 := by omega
          rw [← Int.cast_abs]; exact_mod_cast this
        calc |(j : ℝ)| * |ε| ≤ (q - 1) * (1 / (q * Q)) :=
              mul_le_mul hjq' hα (abs_nonneg _) (by linarith)
          _ ≤ 1 / Q := by
              rw [div_eq_mul_one_div 1 Q, mul_one_div, mul_one_div, div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hQ]

/-- **Montgomery's inequality** (case `ω(p) = 1`): for squarefree `r` and `a(n)` supported on
`n` coprime to `r`, `|S(α)|² ≤ φ(r) ∑_{b < r, (b,r)=1} |S(α + b/r)|²`. -/
theorem montgomery_ineq {r : ℕ} (hr : Squarefree r) (s : Finset ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ)
    (hs : ∀ n ∈ s, Nat.Coprime n r) (α : ℝ) :
    ‖∑ n ∈ s, a n * e (α * n)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (Nat.totient r : ℝ) * ∑ b ∈ (range r).filter r.Coprime,

proof_context.conclusion: Montgomery's inequality for squarefree r: |S(alpha)|^2 <= phi(r) sum_{b<r,(b,r)=1}|S(alpha+b/r)|^2 for a supported on n coprime to r.

ends.snippet:
have hMont : ∀ m : ℤ, ∀ r ∈ C, (1 / Nat.totient r : ℝ) * ‖primeExpSum W' W (α * m)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ∑ b ∈ (range r).filter r.Coprime, ‖primeExpSum W' W (α * m + b / r)‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro m r hr
    obtain ⟨hr1, hrR, hrsq, _⟩ := hCmem r hr
    have hφ : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.totient r := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.2 hr1
    have hM := montgomery_ineq hrsq ((Ioc ⌊W'⌋₊ ⌊W⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime)
      (fun n => (Real.log n : ℂ)) (by
        intro p hp
        rw [mem_filter, mem_Ioc] at hp
        refine (Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hp.2).2 fun hpr => ?_
        have : p ≤ r := Nat.le_of_dvd hr1 hpr
        have h2 : W' < (⌊W'⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one W'
        have h3 : (p : ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast this
        have h4 : (⌊W'⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1 ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp.1.1
        linarith) (α * m)
    simp only [primeExpSum] at hM ⊢
    rw [one_div, ← div_eq_inv_mul, div_le_iff₀ hφ]
    linarith [hM]

proof_context.conclusion: Applies it with a(n)=log n on the primes in (W',W] (coprime to r since r<=R<=W'<p) to get (1/phi(r))|S(alpha m)|^2 <= sum_b |S(alpha m + b/r)|^2.

theorem two_log_le_sub_inv {z : ℝ} (hz : 1 ≤ z) : 2 * Real.log z ≤ z - 1 / z := by

/-- **Landau's lemma.** `f` entire, `f(c) ≠ 0`, `|f| ≤ B` on `|z − c| ≤ R`, `|f(c)| < B`. For
`|z − c| ≤ R/4` with `f(z) ≠ 0`:
`|f'(z)/f(z) − Σ_{|ρ−c|<R/2} m_ρ/(z − ρ)| ≤ 48 log(B/|f(c)|)/R`. -/
theorem landau (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (hfc : f c ≠ 0) (hR : 0 < R) {B : ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ z ∈ closedBall c R, ‖f z‖ ≤ B) (hBc : ‖f c‖ < B) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ closedBall c (R / 4))
    (hfz : f z ≠ 0) :
    ‖logDeriv f z - ∑ u ∈ zerosIn f c R (R / 2), ((divB f c R u).toNat : ℂ) / (z - u)‖ ≤
      48 * Real.log (B / ‖f c‖) / R := by

proof_context.conclusion: Landau's lemma via Borel-Caratheodory: for entire f with |f|<=B on the disc, |f'/f(z) minus the zero sum over |rho-c|<R/2| <= 48 log(B/|f(c)|)/R for |z-c|<=R/4.

    (hZ : ∀ k : ℕ, ∑ u ∈ S.filter (fun u => (⌊u.im / h⌋ + J).toNat = k), m u ≤ Z)

    ∑ u ∈ S, m u * ‖f u.im‖ ≤
      Z * ((1 / h) * (∫ t in (-(J * h))..(J * h), ‖f t‖) + ∫ t in (-(J * h))..(J * h), ‖f' t‖) := by
  have hfc : Continuous f := continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun t => (hf t).continuousAt

  set a : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => ((k : ℝ) - J) * h with ha
  set W : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => (1 / h) * (∫ t in a k..a (k + 1), ‖f t‖) + ∫ t in a k..a (k + 1), ‖f' t‖
    with hW
  have hW0 : ∀ k, 0 ≤ W k := by
    intro k
    have hak : a k ≤ a (k + 1) := by simp only [ha]; push_cast; nlinarith
    have i1 := intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (μ := volume) hak fun t _ => norm_nonneg (f t)
    have i2 := intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg (μ := volume) hak fun t _ => norm_nonneg (f' t)
    simp only [hW]; positivity
  -- each zero lies in its window
  have hwin : ∀ u ∈ S, idx u < 2 * J ∧ u.im ∈ Icc (a (idx u)) (a (idx u + 1)) := by
    intro u hu
    have hb := abs_le.1 (hS u hu)
    have hT0h : T0 / h < J := by rw [div_lt_iff₀ hh]; exact hJ
    have hl : -(J : ℝ) < u.im / h := by
      rw [lt_div_iff₀ hh]; linarith
    have hr : u.im / h < J := lt_of_le_of_lt (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hb.2 hh.le) hT0h
    have hfl1 : -(J : ℤ) ≤ ⌊u.im / h⌋ := by
      rw [Int.le_floor]; push_cast; linarith
    have hfl2 : ⌊u.im / h⌋ < J := by
      rw [Int.floor_lt]; push_cast; exact hr
    have hnn : 0 ≤ ⌊u.im / h⌋ + J := by linarith
    have hk : ((idx u : ℕ) : ℤ) = ⌊u.im / h⌋ + J := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hnn
    have hkR : ((idx u : ℕ) : ℝ) = (⌊u.im / h⌋ : ℝ) + J := by exact_mod_cast hk
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [ha]; rw [hkR]
      have := Int.floor_le (u.im / h)
      have : (⌊u.im / h⌋ : ℝ) * h ≤ u.im := by rwa [le_div_iff₀ hh] at this
      nlinarith
    · simp only [ha]; push_cast; rw [hkR]
      have := Int.lt_floor_add_one (u.im / h)
      have : u.im < ((⌊u.im / h⌋ : ℝ) + 1) * h := by rwa [div_lt_iff₀ hh] at this
      nlinarith
  have hpt : ∀ u ∈ S, ‖f u.im‖ ≤ W (idx u) := by
    intro u hu
    have h1 := norm_le_sobolev hf hf' (a := a (idx u)) (b := a (idx u + 1))
      (by simp only [ha]; push_cast; nlinarith) (hwin u hu).2
    have e : a (idx u + 1) - a (idx u) = h := by simp only [ha]; push_cast; ring
    rw [e] at h1
    exact h1
  calc ∑ u ∈ S, m u * ‖f u.im‖ ≤ ∑ u ∈ S, m u * W (idx u) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun u hu => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hpt u hu) (hm u hu)
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * J), ∑ u ∈ S.filter (fun u => idx u = k), m u * W (idx u) :=
        (Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (fun u hu => Finset.mem_range.2 (hwin u hu).1) _).symm
    _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * J), W k * ∑ u ∈ S.filter (fun u => idx u = k), m u := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun u hu => ?_
        rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hu).2]; ring
    _ ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * J), W k * Z :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hZ k) (hW0 k)
    _ = Z * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * J), W k := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]; exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by ring
    _ = _ := by
        congr 1
        simp only [hW]
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
          intervalIntegral.sum_integral_adjacent_intervals (fun k _ => hfc.norm.intervalIntegrable _ _),

        congr 3 <;> ring

/-- **Cauchy–Schwarz on an interval** (via AM–GM): `∫_a^b |g| ≤ √(A(b − a))` if `∫ |g|² ≤ A`. -/
theorem intervalIntegral_norm_le_sqrt {g : ℝ → ℂ} (hg : Continuous g)
    (hg2 : Integrable fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2) {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hgA : ∫ t, ‖g t‖ ^ 2 ≤ A)
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) :
    ∫ t in a..b, ‖g t‖ ≤ √(A * (b - a)) := by
  set L := b - a with hL
  have hL0 : 0 < L := by rw [hL]; linarith
  set s := √(A * L) with hs
  have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = A * L := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  set c := s / L with hc
  have hc0 : 0 < c := by positivity
  have hpt : ∀ t, ‖g t‖ ≤ ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c) + c / 2 := by
    intro t
    rw [div_add_div _ _ (by positivity) (by norm_num), le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖g t‖ - c)]
  have hgc := hg
  have i1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c)) volume a b :=
    (by fun_prop : Continuous fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have i2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c) + c / 2) volume a b :=
    (by fun_prop : Continuous fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c) + c / 2).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have h1 : ∫ t in a..b, ‖g t‖ ≤ ∫ t in a..b, (‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c) + c / 2) :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hab.le (hg.norm.intervalIntegrable _ _) i2 fun t _ => hpt t
  have h2 : ∫ t in a..b, ‖g t‖ ^ 2 ≤ A := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le]
    exact (setIntegral_le_integral hg2 (Eventually.of_forall fun t => by positivity)).trans hgA
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add i1 intervalIntegrable_const, intervalIntegral.integral_div, intervalIntegral.integral_const,

  have h3 : (∫ t in a..b, ‖g t‖ ^ 2) / (2 * c) ≤ A / (2 * c) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h2 (by positivity)
  have h4 : A / (2 * c) + (b - a) * (c / 2) = s := by
    rw [← hL, hc]; field_simp; nlinarith [hs2]
  linarith

/-- **Mellin–Plancherel**: `∫ |G_δ(1/2 + it)|² dt = 2π ∫₀^∞ (u² e^{−u²/2})² du`. -/

  simp_rw [G_half_eq_fourier]
  have h1 := Measure.integral_comp_div (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖𝓕 (Fhalf δ) ξ‖ ^ 2) (2 * π)
  rw [h1, abs_of_pos (by positivity), smul_eq_mul,
    TernaryGoldbach.integral_norm_sq_fourier (integrable_Fhalf δ) (memLp_Fhalf δ)]
  congr 1
  -- `∫ e^{−u} |fδ(e^{−u})|² du = ∫₀^∞ |fδ|²` via `mellin_eq_fourier` at `s = 1`
  set g : ℝ → ℂ := fun v => (((v ^ 2 * Real.exp (-v ^ 2 / 2)) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) with hg
  have hm := mellin_eq_fourier g (s := (1 : ℂ))
  simp only [Complex.one_re, Complex.one_im, zero_div] at hm
  rw [Real.fourier_eq] at hm
  simp only [inner_zero_right, neg_zero, Real.fourierChar_apply, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero,
    zero_mul, Complex.exp_zero, Circle.smul_def] at hm
  simp only [one_smul] at hm
  rw [mellin] at hm
  have hL : ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), (t : ℂ) ^ ((1:ℂ) - 1) • g t =

    simp only [sub_self, Complex.cpow_zero, one_smul, hg]; exact integral_ofReal
  have hpt : ∀ v : ℝ, Real.exp (-1 * v) • g (Real.exp (-v)) = ((‖Fhalf δ v‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro v
    rw [Complex.real_smul, hg, ← Complex.ofReal_mul]
    congr 1
    rw [norm_Fhalf]
    have h5 : Real.exp (-(5 / 2) * v) ^ 2 = Real.exp (-v) ^ 5 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]; congr 1; push_cast; ring
    have h1 : Real.exp (-1 * v) = Real.exp (-v) := by ring_nf
    rw [h1, mul_pow (Real.exp (-(5 / 2) * v)), h5]
    ring
  have hR : ∫ v, Real.exp (-1 * v) • g (Real.exp (-v)) = ((∫ x, ‖Fhalf δ x‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    simp_rw [hpt]; exact integral_ofReal
  rw [hL, hR] at hm
  exact_mod_cast hm.symm

theorem intervalIntegral_norm_le_sqrt {g : ℝ → ℂ} (hg : Continuous g)
    (hg2 : Integrable fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2) {A : ℝ} (hA : 0 < A) (hgA : ∫ t, ‖g t‖ ^ 2 ≤ A)
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) :
    ∫ t in a..b, ‖g t‖ ≤ √(A * (b - a)) := by
  set L := b - a with hL
  have hL0 : 0 < L := by rw [hL]; linarith
  set s := √(A * L) with hs
  have hs0 : 0 < s := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)
  have hs2 : s ^ 2 = A * L := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  set c := s / L with hc
  have hc0 : 0 < c := by positivity
  have hpt : ∀ t, ‖g t‖ ≤ ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c) + c / 2 := by
    intro t
    rw [div_add_div _ _ (by positivity) (by norm_num), le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖g t‖ - c)]
  have hgc := hg

    (by fun_prop : Continuous fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c)).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have i2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c) + c / 2) volume a b :=
    (by fun_prop : Continuous fun t => ‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c) + c / 2).intervalIntegrable _ _
  have h1 : ∫ t in a..b, ‖g t‖ ≤ ∫ t in a..b, (‖g t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * c) + c / 2) :=
    intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hab.le (hg.norm.intervalIntegrable _ _) i2 fun t _ => hpt t
  have h2 : ∫ t in a..b, ‖g t‖ ^ 2 ≤ A := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le]
    exact (setIntegral_le_integral hg2 (Eventually.of_forall fun t => by positivity)).trans hgA
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add i1 intervalIntegrable_const, intervalIntegral.integral_div, intervalIntegral.integral_const,
    smul_eq_mul] at h1
  have h3 : (∫ t in a..b, ‖g t‖ ^ 2) / (2 * c) ≤ A / (2 * c) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h2 (by positivity)
  have h4 : A / (2 * c) + (b - a) * (c / 2) = s := by
    rw [← hL, hc]; field_simp; nlinarith [hs2]

theorem sum_window_fline_le {S : Finset ℂ} (m : ℂ → ℝ) (hm : ∀ u ∈ S, 0 ≤ m u) {h T0 Z : ℝ}

    (hZ : ∀ k : ℕ, ∑ u ∈ S.filter (fun u => (⌊u.im / h⌋ + J).toNat = k), m u ≤ Z) (δ : ℝ) :
    ∑ u ∈ S, m u * ‖fline δ u.im‖ ≤
      Z * ((1 / h) * √(2 * π * 0.6647 * (2 * (J * h))) + √(2 * π * 0.1707 * (2 * (J * h)))) := by
  have hJh : 0 < (J : ℝ) * h := by linarith
  refine (sum_window_le m hm hh J hJ hS hZ0 hZ (hasDerivAt_fline δ) (continuous_flineD δ)).trans ?_
  refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hZ0
  have e : (J : ℝ) * h - -(J * h) = 2 * (J * h) := by ring
  have h1 := intervalIntegral_norm_le_sqrt (continuous_fline δ) (integrable_norm_sq_fline δ)
    (by positivity) (integral_norm_sq_fline_le δ) (a := -(J * h)) (b := J * h) (by linarith)
  have h2 := intervalIntegral_norm_le_sqrt (continuous_flineD δ) (integrable_norm_sq_flineD δ)
    (by positivity) (integral_norm_sq_flineD_le δ) (a := -(J * h)) (b := J * h) (by linarith)
  rw [e] at h1 h2
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 / h)
  linarith

    (hχ1 : χ ≠ 1) {T T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : 0 < T0) (S : Finset ℂ) (hS : S ⊆ zerosRect χ T)
    (hre : ∀ u ∈ S, 0 < u.re ∧ u.re < 1) (him : ∀ u ∈ S, T0 < |u.im|) (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ u ∈ S.filter (fun u => ⌊(|u.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ = k), (multRect χ T u : ℝ) ≤
      2 * Z3 N T0 + 2 * c3 T0 * (k + 1) := by

  set c := T0 + ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * 4.4 with hc
  have hL3 := log_ratio_pos (r := 3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

  have hpos : ∀ u ∈ F, (k : ℝ) * 4.4 ≤ |u.im| - T0 ∧ |u.im| - T0 < ((k : ℝ) + 1) * 4.4 := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨huS, hk⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hu
    have h0 : 0 ≤ (|u.im| - T0) / 4.4 := div_nonneg (by linarith [him u huS]) (by norm_num)
    have h1 := Nat.floor_le h0
    have h2 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one ((|u.im| - T0) / 4.4)
    rw [hk] at h1 h2
    constructor
    · rwa [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)] at h1
    · rwa [div_lt_iff₀ (by norm_num)] at h2
  have hcount : ∀ (F' : Finset ℂ), F' ⊆ F → ∀ c' : ℝ, |c'| = c →
      (∀ u ∈ F', ‖u - (2 + c' * I)‖ ≤ 3) → ∑ u ∈ F', (multRect χ T u : ℝ) ≤ Z3 N T0 + c3 T0 * (k + 1) := by
    intro F' hF' c' hc' hball
    have h1 := sum_multRect_le hχ hχ1 F' ((hF'.trans (Finset.filter_subset _ _)).trans hS) c'
      (r := 3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hball
    have h2 : Real.log (BP N c' / 0.355) ≤ Real.log (BP N T0 / 0.355) + 11 * (((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * 4.4) / T0 := by
      have e : BP N c' = BP N (T0 + ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * 4.4) := by
        unfold BP; rw [hc', hc, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < T0 + ((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * 4.4)]
      rw [e]; exact log_BP_growth N hT0 (by positivity)
    have h3 : 11 * (((k : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * 4.4) / T0 ≤ 11 * 4.4 / T0 * (k + 1) := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hT0]; nlinarith
    refine h1.trans ?_
    unfold Z3 c3
    rw [div_add' _ _ _ hL3.ne', div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hL3]
    rw [show 11 * 4.4 / T0 / Real.log (10 / 3) * ((k : ℝ) + 1) * Real.log (10 / 3) = 11 * 4.4 / T0 * (k + 1) by
      field_simp]
    linarith
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not F (fun u => 0 < u.im)]
  have hp := hcount (F.filter fun u => 0 < u.im) (Finset.filter_subset _ _) c
    (abs_of_pos (by positivity)) (fun u hu => by
      obtain ⟨huF, him0⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hu
      obtain ⟨hp1, hp2⟩ := hpos u huF
      obtain ⟨hr1, hr2⟩ := hre u (Finset.mem_filter.1 huF).1

        rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith)
  linarith

      Cg * (2 * aH) * EA (T0 - 200) δ * rhoA δ ^ ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ := by
  set k := ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ with hk
  have hT0' : max (10 * π * |δ|) 50 ≤ T0 - 200 := by linarith
  have h := norm_mellin_fP_le δ (s := s) (by linarith)
    (B := EB (T0 - 200) * rhoB ^ k + EA (T0 - 200) δ * rhoA δ ^ k) fun ξ hξ => by
    have hsh := abs_shift_le hξ
    have ha : |s.im| - 200 ≤ |s.im + 2 * π * ξ| := by
      have := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub s.im (-(2 * π * ξ)); rw [abs_neg] at this

/-- **The sum over zeros** (generic). -/

    (hcls : ∀ T : ℝ, ∀ u ∈ zerosRectD f T, f u = 0 ∧ (u = 0 ∨ (0 < u.re ∧ u.re < 1)))
    {T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : 50 ≤ T0)
    (hG : ∀ ρ : ℂ, f ρ = 0 → 0 < ρ.re → ρ.re < 1 → |ρ.im| ≤ T0 → ρ.re = 1 / 2)
    (M : ℂ → ℂ) {G0 : ℝ} (hM0 : ‖M 0‖ ≤ G0)
    {F F' : ℝ → ℂ} (hMF : ∀ t : ℝ, M (((1 / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + t * I) = F t)
    (hF : ∀ t, HasDerivAt F (F' t) t) (hF' : Continuous F')
    {Q1 Q2 : ℝ} (hQ1 : 0 < Q1) (hQ2 : 0 < Q2)
    (hF2 : Integrable fun t => ‖F t‖ ^ 2) (hF2' : Integrable fun t => ‖F' t‖ ^ 2)
    (hFQ : ∫ t, ‖F t‖ ^ 2 ≤ Q1) (hFQ' : ∫ t, ‖F' t‖ ^ 2 ≤ Q2)
    {EB' EA' ρB ρA : ℝ} (hEB : 0 ≤ EB') (hEA : 0 ≤ EA') (hρB0 : 0 ≤ ρB) (hρB1 : ρB < 1)
    (hρA0 : 0 ≤ ρA) (hρA1 : ρA < 1)
    (htail : ∀ s : ℂ, 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → T0 < |s.im| →
      ‖M s‖ ≤ EB' * ρB ^ ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊ + EA' * ρA ^ ⌊(|s.im| - T0) / 4.4⌋₊)
    {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (T : ℝ) :
    ‖∑ u ∈ zerosRectD f T, (multRectD f T u : ℂ) * (M u * (x : ℂ) ^ u)‖ ≤
      G0 * Z3g B 0 + √x * E1g B T0 Q1 Q2 + x * E2g B κ T0 EB' EA' ρB ρA := by
  set Z := zerosRectD f T with hZ
  set m : ℂ → ℝ := fun u => (multRectD f T u : ℝ) with hmdef
  have hm : ∀ u, 0 ≤ m u := fun u => Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  have hT00 : 0 < T0 := by linarith
  have h1 : ‖∑ u ∈ Z, (multRectD f T u : ℂ) * (M u * (x : ℂ) ^ u)‖ ≤
      ∑ u ∈ Z, m u * (‖M u‖ * x ^ u.re) := by
    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (Finset.sum_le_sum fun u _ => ?_)
    rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast, norm_cpow_x hx0]
  refine h1.trans ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not Z (fun u => u = 0),
    ← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (Z.filter fun u => ¬ u = 0) (fun u => |u.im| ≤ T0)]
  have hcases : ∀ u ∈ Z.filter (fun u => ¬ u = 0), f u = 0 ∧ 0 < u.re ∧ u.re < 1 := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨huZ, hu0⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hu
    obtain ⟨hL, hc⟩ := hcls T u huZ
    rcases hc with h | h
    · exact absurd h hu0
    · exact ⟨hL, h⟩
  have hG00 : 0 ≤ G0 := (norm_nonneg _).trans hM0
  -- the zero at `0`
  have hA : ∑ u ∈ Z.filter (fun u => u = 0), m u * (‖M u‖ * x ^ u.re) ≤ G0 * Z3g B 0 := by
    have hcount := sum_multRectD_le hp (Z.filter fun u => u = 0) (Finset.filter_subset _ _) 0
      (r := 3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (fun u hu => by
        rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hu).2]; norm_num)
    have hpt : ∀ u ∈ Z.filter (fun u => u = 0), m u * (‖M u‖ * x ^ u.re) ≤ m u * G0 := by
      intro u hu
      rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hu).2, Complex.zero_re, Real.rpow_zero, mul_one]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hM0 (hm 0)
    refine (Finset.sum_le_sum hpt).trans ?_
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, mul_comm]
