theorem gx_antitoneOn {x : ℝ} (hx : 2.16e20 ≤ x) : AntitoneOn (gx x) (Icc 670 (x ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6)) := by
  obtain ⟨hT, -, -, -⟩ := cube_root_facts hx
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by linarith
  obtain ⟨T, hTdef⟩ : ∃ T, T = x ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hTdef] at hT ⊢
  obtain ⟨B, hBdef⟩ : ∃ B, B = Real.log (9 * T / 4.008) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hB : 8.5 ≤ B := by
    rw [hBdef, Real.le_log_iff_exp_le (by positivity)]
    have : rexp 8.5 ≤ rexp 9 := Real.exp_le_exp.2 (by norm_num)
    have h9 : (8200 : ℝ) ≤ 9 * T / 4.008 := by rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; nlinarith
    linarith [exp_nine_le]
  have hsub : Icc 670 (T / 6) ⊆ Icc (rexp 6) (rexp (B - 2.5)) := by
    intro r hr
    refine ⟨exp_six_le.trans hr.1, hr.2.trans ?_⟩
    rw [Real.exp_sub, hBdef, Real.exp_log (by positivity), le_div_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos _)]
    have h1 : T / 6 * rexp 2.5 ≤ T / 6 * 13.4 := by gcongr; exact exp_two_point_five_le
    have h2 : T / 6 * 13.4 ≤ 9 * T / 4.008 := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; nlinarith
    linarith
  have hA := (antitoneOn_comp_log (QA_antitoneOn hB)).mono hsub
  have hC := (antitoneOn_comp_log (QC_antitoneOn (B - 2.5))).mono hsub
  intro a ha b hb hab
  have ha0 : 0 < a := by linarith [ha.1]
  have hb0 : 0 < b := by linarith [hb.1]
  rw [gx_eq hx0 ha0, gx_eq hx0 hb0, ← hTdef, ← hBdef]
  have h1 := hA ha hb hab
  have h2 := hC ha hb hab
  simp only at h1 h2
  have h3 : 2.526 / √(2 * b) ≤ 2.526 / √(2 * a) :=
    div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by positivity) (Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (by linarith))
  have h4 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 (Real.sqrt_nonneg 2)
  linarith

proof_context.conclusion: The single-scale bound g_x(r) is non-increasing in r on [670, x^{1/3}/6] for x ≥ 2.16·10²⁰.

    le_trans (by exact_mod_cast (mem_Ioc.1 hn).2) (Nat.floor_le (by positivity))

    have hs0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg x
    have : √x ≤ x := by nlinarith

  rw [eTerm, if_neg (fun h => hp h.1), lamNP, if_neg hp]

      have : Real.log n ≤ Real.log (2 ^ (j + 1) * x) := Real.log_le_log hn0 h2
      rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity) hx0.ne', Real.log_pow] at this

    have : (2 : ℝ) ^ i ≤ 2 ^ k := pow_le_pow_right₀ (by norm_num) hik

    apply Nat.le_floor

    intro n hn

      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hψ (by linarith : 0 ≤ Real.log x / 2)

      linarith
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left this (by norm_num)

  have hr1 : r < 1 := by

    rw [hr]; linarith

    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hc
    have := Real.log_nonneg (by norm_num : (1:ℝ) ≤ 2)
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left g2 this
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left g1 hlx

    linarith
  rw [hsplit] at hstep1
  linarith

    intro α

    have := (hs.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
    exact ((continuous_norm.pow 2).tendsto _).comp this
  have hlim := tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence (μ := volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0:ℝ) 1))
    (F := fun (X : ℕ) (α : ℝ) => ‖expSum X a α‖ ^ 2) (f := fun α => ‖expTsum a α‖ ^ 2)
    (fun _ => B ^ 2)
    (fun X => ((continuous_expSum X a).norm.pow 2).aestronglyMeasurable)
    (integrable_const _)
    (fun X => Eventually.of_forall fun α => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖expSum X a α‖ ^ 2)]

    (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique hlim h2

theorem antitoneOn_eta2log : AntitoneOn (eta2log ρ) (Set.Icc (1 / 2) 1) := by

  unfold eta2log

  have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith [hs.1]
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith [ht.1]
  -- With `A = log ρ`, `u = -log s ≥ v = -log t ≥ 0`, `u ≤ log 2 ≤ A/2`: `(A-v)v ≤ (A-u)u`.

  set v := -Real.log t

    have := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hρ
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow] at this; push_cast at this; linarith

    simp only [u]
    have := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) (show (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ s from hs.1)
    rw [one_div, Real.log_inv] at this; linarith
  have hvu : v ≤ u := by simp only [u, v]; linarith [Real.log_le_log hs0 hst]
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := by simp only [v]; linarith [Real.log_nonpos ht0.le ht.2]

    rw [Real.log_mul (by linarith) hs0.ne']; simp only [A, u]; ring

    rw [Real.log_mul (by linarith) ht0.ne']; simp only [A, v]; ring

/-- **[H, Lemma B.2.3, (B.11)]**: `|η̂_(ρ)''|_∞ ≤ 31.521 log ρ` for `ρ ≥ 4`, written as
`(2πt)² |η̂_(ρ)(t)| ≤ c₀ log ρ`. By `ghat_eta2log`, `η̂_(ρ) = (log·η₂)^ + log ρ · η̂₂`. For `ρ = 4`,
`(2πt)² |η̂_(4)| ≤ 48 log 2 = 24 log 4` (`norm_eta2log4_le`, two integrations by parts, no numerics).
For `ρ > 4`, the extra `(log ρ − log 4) η̂₂` is bounded by (B.6) (`eta2_fourier_bound'`). -/
theorem eta2log_fourier_bound (t : ℝ) :
    (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖𝓕 (fun u => (eta2log ρ u : ℂ)) t‖ ≤ c₀ * Real.log ρ := by
  have h4 := ghat_eta2log (ρ := 4) le_rfl t
  have hρt := ghat_eta2log hρ t
  set A := eta2hat t
  set B := ghat (fun u => Real.log u * eta2 u) t
  have hA : (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖A‖ ≤ c₀ := eta2_fourier_bound' t
  have hk : ‖((2 * π * t) ^ 2 : ℂ)‖ = (2 * π * t) ^ 2 := by
    rw [show ((2 * π * t) ^ 2 : ℂ) = (((2 * π * t) ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) by push_cast; ring,
      Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
  have h48 : (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖B + (Real.log 4 : ℂ) * A‖ ≤ 48 * Real.log 2 := by
    have h := norm_eta2log4_le t
    have e : 𝓕 (fun u => ((Real.log (4 * u) * eta2 u : ℝ) : ℂ)) t = ghat (eta2log 4) t := rfl
    rw [e, h4, norm_mul, hk] at h
    exact h
  have hL : Real.log 4 ≤ Real.log ρ := Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hρ
  have hL4 : Real.log 4 = 2 * Real.log 2 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]; norm_num
  have hl2 := Real.log_pos (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2)
  have hsplit : B + (Real.log ρ : ℂ) * A = (B + (Real.log 4 : ℂ) * A) +
      ((Real.log ρ - Real.log 4 : ℝ) : ℂ) * A := by push_cast; ring
  have hn : ‖B + (Real.log ρ : ℂ) * A‖ ≤ ‖B + (Real.log 4 : ℂ) * A‖ +
      (Real.log ρ - Real.log 4) * ‖A‖ := by
    rw [hsplit]
    refine (norm_add_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
  show (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖ghat (eta2log ρ) t‖ ≤ c₀ * Real.log ρ
  rw [hρt]
  have hk0 : 0 ≤ (2 * π * t) ^ 2 := by positivity
  calc (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖B + (Real.log ρ : ℂ) * A‖
      ≤ (2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖B + (Real.log 4 : ℂ) * A‖ +
          (Real.log ρ - Real.log 4) * ((2 * π * t) ^ 2 * ‖A‖) := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn hk0; nlinarith
    _ ≤ 48 * Real.log 2 + (Real.log ρ - Real.log 4) * c₀ := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hA (by linarith : 0 ≤ Real.log ρ - Real.log 4)
        linarith
    _ ≤ c₀ * Real.log ρ := by unfold c₀; nlinarith

  have h2 : 0 ≤ 4 * Real.log (4 * s) := by
    have := Real.log_nonneg (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ 4 * s by linarith [hs.1]); linarith
  have h3 : Real.log (ρ * s) ≤ Real.log (ρ * t) := Real.log_le_log (by positivity) (by nlinarith)

/-- The trivial bound `|S_{η₂}(α, z)| ≤ 3 ψ(z) ≤ 17 z`. -/
theorem norm_S_eta2_le_trivial {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) (α : ℝ) : ‖S eta2 z α‖ ≤ 17 * z := by
  unfold S
  have hs : ∀ n ∉ Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1),
      ((Λ n * eta2 (n / z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α) = 0 := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt, Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.floor_lt hz.le] at hn
    rw [eta2_eq_zero, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul]
    rintro ⟨-, h1⟩
    rw [div_lt_one hz] at h1
    linarith
  rw [tsum_eq_sum hs]
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
  have h1 : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1),
      ‖((Λ n * eta2 (n / z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α)‖ ≤ 3 * Λ n := by
    intro n _
    rw [norm_mul, TernaryGoldbach.norm_e, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (eta2_nonneg _))]
    nlinarith [eta2_le (n / z), @ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg n]
  refine (Finset.sum_le_sum h1).trans ?_
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  have hpsi : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1), Λ n = Chebyshev.psi z := by
    have e : Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1) = insert 0 (Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊z⌋₊) := by
      ext n; simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Ioc]; omega
    rw [e, Finset.sum_insert (by simp), ArithmeticFunction.map_zero, zero_add]
    rfl
  rw [hpsi]
  have h4 : Real.log 4 < 1.3863 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]
    have := Real.log_two_lt_d9; push_cast; linarith
  have := Chebyshev.psi_le_const_mul_self hz.le
  nlinarith

proof_context.conclusion: Unconditional bound ‖S_{η₂}(α,z)‖ ≤ 17z via ψ(z) ≤ (log 4+4)z; no explicit formula over zeros.
